tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil chog ste/

/chos ser ldan pa yid la bzhag/ lhag ma lce la don ldan du//legs par blangs pas dge legs 'phel// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan bla ma 'jam pa'i mgon la dus thams cad du rnam pa thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin mchog dri med gzis/ /'gro ba'i long rgyu nang mun ma lus pa/ /bsal nas yid kyi ge sar bzhad pa'i dpal/ /gang de'i dge legs 'gro 'dir khyab gyur cig /mgon 'dir gus 'dud bdud sde bag yod rigs/ /lha mos glu longs khro bos bgegs kun choms/ /'gro kun 'jam dbyangs gzhal med khang bzang du/ /bzung phyir shis brjod dar dir da sgrogs shig /gang zhig thob na rdo rje 'dzin dpal gyi/ /sku bzhi'i nus pa nges par sgrub byed pa'i/ /dbang bskur cho ga 'jam dbyangs bzhed pa bzhin/ /mgon der rtag tu rol pas 'dir bshad bya/ /de yang 'di'-i dkyil chog slob dpon chen po mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa'i bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa dang de'i 'grel pa rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa shān+ti pas mdzad pa gnyis la gzhi byas/ 'di'i dkyil chog slob dpon bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa sogs dang*/ 'di dang cha mthun pa 'phags lugs kyi cho ga nyi shu pa dang zung 'jug gsal ba dang*/ 'di gtso bor byas pa'i dkyil 'khor kun gyi cho ga rdo rje phreng ba rnams kyis nges par kha 'gengs dgos rnams bkang ste mkhas pa yid ches shing kun gyis 'jug bde bar brjod par bya'o/ / 'di la drugaslob dpon gang gis/ yul gang la/ gnas gang du/ dus nam gyi tshe/ dkyil 'khor gang du/ cho ga ji lta bus dbang bskur ba'o/ / dang po ni/ slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ dpal ldan 'dus pa'i gzhung mchog tu/ /'khor lo man ngag rim pa yis/ /chu thog rjes gnang tha ma yis| |bla mar dbang thob nges nas ni/ /de nyid mthong ba gang yin pas/

/'di yi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /gsang dang shes rab dbang thob cing*/ /gsang dang rnal 'byor de nyid shes/ /theg gsum dgongs pa'i de nyid rig/snying po rigs sngags phyag rgya dang*/ /ting 'dzin rnam pa gsum yang shes/ /thun mong gcig shos dngos grub thob/ /rgyud dngagazhung gi rnam dbye mkhas/ /dam tshig sdom la rab gnas shing*/ /shes rab rnal 'byor la rab brtson/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /sems can don 'grub skal ba can/ /gtong dang brtan pa sogs ldan pa/ /zhes pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas/ /snying rje brtul zhugs bzlas par ldan| |dad ldan zab mo de nyid rig /rang gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pas/ /sngon du bsnyen pa byas nas su/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu bri bar bya/ zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i slob dpon mchog yin la/ 'bring du yang*/ ji ltar rigs pa'i sngags bzlas te| |rang gi bdag po'i bka' thob pa'am/ /'gog pa'i 'khor lo goms pa yis/ rang sems dag pas 'bri bar bya/ /zhes pa ltar bsnyen pa mthar son nas/ /lhas gnang ba thob pa'am/ bsrung 'khor la brtan pa thob pa'o/ /tha ma'ang/ dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor bri zhing bsgrub pa sogs la mkhas// bsnyen pa song bas/ lhas ma bkag par shes pa zhig slob dpon du bya'o/ /bsnyen pa'i tshad ni/ dkyil 'khor dbus kyi gtso bo yi/ /sngags ni 'bum phrag bzlas par bya/ /gzhan dag rnams kyi khri yin te/ /rang gi rigs kyi lha yi 'bum/ /zhes pa ltar rgyud dang rgya gzhung khungs thub du ma nas gsungs pa nyid do/ / gnyis pa ni yid gzhungs spro ba che ba dang*/ /byas pa bzo zhing nga rgyal med/ /rigs mtho yon tan ldan zhing dad/ /gzugs dang kha dog lang tshor ldan| |zhes pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa ni rab yin la/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsang ba ni/ /sgrub la don gnyen mngon brtson na/ /gzugs ngan yon tan med pa dang*| |dman pa gzhan yang lhag gnas bya/ /zhes pa ltar yang rung ste/

de yang rang rang bslab la legs gnas shing*/ /theg chen la dga'i bdag nyid can// 'khor ni bzhi po dag la yang*/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga rjes su gnang*/ /zhes dge bsnyen pha ma yan chad kyi sdom ldan dgos pa ltar gsungs pa ni spyir mi dge bcu spong tsam la dgongs kyis so sor thar pa nges ldan du mi bzung ngo*/ /des na de lta bu'i slob ma'am/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha lta bu ni dbang gzhan la bskur ba'i yul yin la/ rang nyid sdom pa gso ba dang/ lam sgrub pa'i don du 'di'i dkyil 'khor bris shing bsgrubs nas dbang len pa la ni rang nyid yul yin no/ / gsum pa ni/ 'dir dngos su ma bshad kyang/ phreng bar/ sa gzhi/ dbus shin tu mtho na nor nyams shing 'chi ba'am/ byang mtho na rigs brgyud chad pa dang*/ shar mtho shing dbus dma' na sgrub pa po nyams/ sa de'i shar sogs phyogs bzhi na/ rim pa bzhin/ shing a shwad tha dang/ pa la k+sha dang/ n+ya gro dha dang/ ba ku la rnams dang*/ me sogs mtshams bzhi na ardzun/ pa la sha /sa la ma li/ u dum wa ra rnams yod na'ang 'chi ba'am nor nyams par 'gyur bas de rnams spangs te/ sa phyogs dbus cung zad mtho ba/ gru bzhi pa/ dkar la 'jam pa/ chu'i rgyun g.yas skor gyis dbang ldan mtshams su 'bab pa ni/ rgyal srid dam rigs 'grub pa'i rgyu yin pas de lta bur byas la/ de yang grong khyer la sogs pa'i phyi rol gyi shar sogs phyogs bzhir 'bri na rim pa bzhin sa'i bdag po dang*/ sbyin bdag dang slob dpon dang slob ma rnams la ngan pa dang*/ me srin rlung rnams su char dang mu ge dang rlung 'byung bas dbang ldan gyi phyogs su bya zhing*/ mchod rten gyi drung dang*/ klu gnas pa'i chu dang nye ba dang*/ shing gi grib ma la bris na 'chi ba dang chu 'byung ba dang byis pa 'chi bas de rnams spangs pa'i gnas su bya zhing*/ khang khyim la sogs pa'i nang du'am grong khyer la sogs pa med pa'i sar ni sa phyogs yid du 'ong zhing shar dang byang gzhol ba'i sar dkyil 'khor bri zhing sgrub par bya'o/

/ bzhi pa ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud sogs nas gzhan du gsungs kyang*/ phreng bar| mgo dang mchu dang dbo dang sa ga dang snron dang chu stod rnams sam/ dus 'khor nas nag pa dang*/ rgyud gzhan nas smin drug dang tha skar gyi zla ba rnams kyi tshes gnyis dang gsum dang lnga dang bdun dang bcu dang bcu gsum dang bco lnga rnams la/ gza' zla ba dang lhag pa dang phur bu dang pa sangs rnams dang*/ skar ma snar ma dang mgo dang lag dang rgyal dang*/ dbo dang me bzhi dang*/ lha mtshams dang snron dang snubs dang gro zhun dang*/ chu stod dang chu smad dang*/ khrums stod dang khrums smad rnams la bya zhing*/ sbyor ba/ sel pa dang shin tu bskrang pa dang*/ zug rngu dang 'bras dang*/ bya ma grub dang*/ rdo rje dang kun ltung dang*/ yongs snun dang*/ mkhon 'dzin rnams spangs zhing/ byed pa bīṣ+ti bor ba'i dus tshes bzang po dus sbyor rtsis ba'i yud tsam yang bzang po'i dus su bya bar bshad do/ / lnga pa ni/ bum dbang gang du thob pa'i dkyil 'khor ni bzhi ste/ rdul tshon dang*/ ras bris dang*/ lus dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /mchog dbang gong du thob pa'i dkyil 'khor ni gsum te/ kun rdzob dang don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor gnyis dang bha ga'i dkyil 'khor rnams te/ lugs 'di la ni lus kyi dkyil 'khor med pas phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor drug tu bya zhing phyi'i gsum las rngul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gtso bor byas nas bshad par bya'o/ /drug pa la gnyis/ rnam gzhag bshad pa dang lag len la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon klu byang gis phyi dkyil la cho ga nyi shu dang*/ phreng bar dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang bcas pa cho ga lnga bcu bshad pa sogs byung zhing*/ 'dir cho ga'i grangs tshad nges can ma byung yang*/ sa chog la sbyang bzung gnyis dang*/ sta gon/ sa lha dang*/ lha dang*/ bum pa dang*/ slob ma sta gon ste bzhi dang*/ bri sgrub la/

thig gdab pa tshon dgye ba dang sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ bdag 'jug cing gsol ba gdab pa ste drug dang*/ slob ma 'jug pa la yang gdong g.yogs dang bcas te 'jug pa dang med pa gnyis/ dbang bskur ba la/ chu dang cod pan dang rdo rje dang dril bu ming dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ slob dpon dang*| gsang ba dang*/ shes rab ye shes dang lung bstan dang*/ rjes gnang dang dbugs dbyung ste bcu gnyis rim pa 'di bzhin du gsungs la/ sa sbyang ba'i sngon du brtag pa ma gsungs shing*/ zhing skyong dang bde gshegs dang sa lha la blang ba gsum gsungs la 'grel pa dang*/ slob dpon bsod snyoms pas sa rkos te dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa byed pa'i dbang du byas nas phyi'i sbyang ba zhes bshad cing*/ rdzas sngags sogs kyis sbyor ba la nang gi sbyang ba zhes bshad do/ /sa bzung ba la shān+ti pas bdag bskyed rdzogs pa'i rjes su nga rgyal bzung ba la sgo bzhi'i slob mas gsol ba gdab par bshad cing*/ rtsa 'grel kun gyis spro ba skyed pa dang snyan mnan pa rnams ma gsungs la/ gsol gdab kyi rjes su/ khro bor bsgoms nas dkyil 'khor 'degs par bshad cing*/ phur gdab ni slob dpon bsod snyoms pas sa bzung gi 'jug 'dogs su byas la/ shān+ti pas lha sta gon gyi sngon 'gror mdzad do/ /de ltar na sa chog ni rang gzhung gi 'di dag rtsa ba gzhir byas te/ phreng bar bshad pa rnams kyis kha bskang bar bya'o/ /sta gon dang bri sgrub rnams ni 'di dag du ji ltar 'byung ba gzhan nas cung zad kha bkang bas 'grub la/ 'jug pa'i skabs su chas 'jug byas nas yi ge gsum gyis lus 'od gsal bar byas pa la rigs dang mos pa dris nas me tog gi phreng ba gtad de/ yon 'bul du bcug nas sems bskyed pa dang*/ yol ba'i nang du bzhugs nas thun mong gi sdom pa bzung ba la dam bzhag byed par bshad cing dam bzhag la gtso bor nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ma bshad do/

/thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom bzung slob dpon dbang gi sngon du bshad do/ /brtul zhugs kyi dbang ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi sngon 'gro dam tshig dang po gnyis la bshad cing rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ma bskur ba la'ang byar rung ba dang*/ /lung bstan dbugs dbyung gnyis ni sbyir slob dpon gyi dbang ma thob pa la byed par mi rigs te/ de gnyis phyir mi ldog pa'i sa dang 'brel ba'i phyir ro zhes pa'i spyir btang dang/ byang chub la mos pa bskyed pa'i rkyen du 'gyur na gang zag khyad par can la byar rung ba'i dmigs bsal dang rjes gnang la rtsa ba dang bsod snyoms pas chos 'khor bskor ba'i rjes gnang dang rang nyid dngos grub sgrub pa'i rjes gnang tsam med la/ shān+ti pas mig sman dang me long dang*| dril bu dang*/ mda' gzhu dang yang me long dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ dung dang glegs bam dang*/ yang dril bu dang sngags kyi rjes gnang rnams bshad kyang phreng bar dril bu dang me long re bshad pa ltar bya zhing*/ thams cad kyi dbang bzhi pa dbang bskur bcu gnyis kyi nang du ma bgrangs kyang*/ gsum pa'i 'jug thogs su bshad do/ /rtsa bar dbang bcu gnyis po yang 'bras bu bzhir bsdus te/ brtul zhugs lung bstan rjes gnang dbugs dbyung bzhi dbang gi 'khor yin pas dbang gi gtso bo brgyad po las/ chu dang cod pan rgyu mthun te/ /rdo rje bdag po ming rnam smin| |sangs rgyas dbang bskur skyes bu ste/ /gsang dang rnal 'byor bral pa'o// zhes pa'i bdag po ni dril bu dang sangs rgyas ni slob dpon dang rnal 'byor ni shes rab ye shes so/ / gnyis pa la gsum/ sngon du bsnyen ba'i bya ba/ bar du dkyil 'khor gyi las rim/ tha mar 'jug gi cho ga'o/ / dang po ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob mas gsol ba lan gnyis sam gsum la sogs par 'debs pa na khas blangs tai/ slob ma bsrung ba'i don du| slob ma'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer drag cing tsha bas snying khar sdig sgrib thams cad 'dus pa'i yi ge kaṃ las byung ba'i sdig pa rwa can shin tu mi sdug pa'i gzugs can dor nas sna sgor 'thon zhing*/

hūm̐ yig kyang snying khar song ba yongs su gyur ba las khro bo rdo rje gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po rab tu khros zhing bsus pa 'phyang ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yasapas rdo rje'i mche ba 'phyar zhing g.yon pas sdig 'dzub mche ba ltar bsgreng ba/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa sna bug nas thon pa'i zhal du sdig pa gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha khā da khā da pa paṃ ni a sa hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum la sogs pa brjod/ de nas slob ma saṃ las kun bzang du bskyed pa'i sems kyi bgegs la bdud rtsi thal sbyor gyi ming can bgegs btab pa'i phur bu'i me 'od kyis gdug pa can thams cad bsregs par gyur cing de'i snying khar ā las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor aḥlas byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan par bsams te/ nyer mkho bsog tu bcug la/ rang nyid bsnyen pa sngon du song na/ lha'i rnal 'byor bsgoms nas rmi lam dang mtshan ma la sogs pa'i ltas brtag pa tsam byas la| ma song na ma mtha' grangs kyi bsnyen pa la 'bad par bya ste/ bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas par/ /dkyil 'khor las la 'jug na sbom po'i ltung ba 'byung zhing lhas ma gnang ba'am bkag pas bgegs kyi bar chad byed pa dang*/ slob ma la sku bzhi'i sa bon bskrun mi nus shing ye shes mi phebs pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa la/ dpal mchog las/ zhag gcig nas bco lnga'i bar dang*/ dus 'khor nas zhag drug la rdzogs par byed pa'i tshul bshad kyang*/ 'dir*/ spyi rgyud las/ rnam bcad dang po sa gzhi bzung*/ / gnyis pa la ni sta gon bya/ /nub gsum pa la 'jug pa shis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar byas la/ spro zhing long yod na snga ma gnyis ltar yang rung ngo*/ /'di la gsum/ sa chogasta gon/ dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po la brtag pa/ bslang ba/ sbyang ba/ bzung ba/ bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab pa'o/ dang po la phyogs dang mtshan nyid kyi brtag pa sogs ni sngar bshad pa'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid ltar yin la/

'dir kha dog gi sgo nas zhi rgyas la/ rkos pa'i sa dkar zhing bsnum pa sogs dang*/ dri'i sgo nas tsan dan la sogs pa'i dri zhim po bro ba/ ro yi sgo nas bska ba dang*/ mngar ba la sogs pa rnams bzang la/ der pus nub tsam du dong drus nas sa de nyid kyis bkang bas lhag na rab/ mnyam na 'bring*| ma khengs na spang ngo*/ /de nas sa rnams gsal nas khung bu 'thas par bcags te chus bkang bas g.yas su 'khor na rab mi 'khor na 'bring g.yon du 'khor na ngan/ sgra dang bcas na 'jigs pa 'byung ngo*/ /de nas shar du gom pa brgya tham pa phyin te phyir log pa na chu ma bri na rab/ phyed tsam bri na 'bring*/ /skams na ngan pas spang*/ bgegs dang bcas par rig na bsrung 'khor bsgom pa dang*/ bgegs mthar byed kyi bzlas brjod bya ste/ de ltar na brtag pa la kha dog dri ro sa chus brtag pa bzhi'o/ / gnyis pa la snang ba las blang ba ni/ gnas de'i bdag po la rin nam tshig gis blang ba'o/ /mi snang ba las blang ba la gsum las dang po 'jig rten skyong ba las blang ba ni sa der bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang yi ge gsum bzlas pa'i dri bzang gi chus gsang gtor byas mchod gtor bshams nas/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma ji lta ba bzhin du phyogs skyong bcu la mchod gtor gshegs gsol gyi bar byas la/ khyad par dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ /de ltar khyod la bdag gis ni/ /gus pas gsol gyis ma bslu bar/ /rmi lam la sogs mtshan ma dang*/ /legs nyes ltas rnams bstan du gsol zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab bo/

/ gnyis pa sa lha las blang ba ni/ sngar bzhin gsang gtor byas pa'i dbus su dri'i thig le me tog gi tshom bu dang bcas pa byas te/ oṃ āḥbagh+win+ta kṛ ta hūm̐| zhes pa'i las thams cad pas bsangs/ shūn+yatās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la baṃ las byung ba'i sa lha ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yon bum pa 'dzin cing*/ g.yas dbang por khas len pa/ dga' ba dang ldan pa'i thugs can zhi ba/ nam bza' ser po bsnams shing rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur/ rang gi lag pa g.yas par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ gsum gyis mtshan pa'i 'od zer dang lag pa rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas sa la lan gsum rdabs pa'i sgra dang hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes brjod pa'i sgras sa g.yos pa'i gseb nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i sa lha ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐ hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis rigs lnga spyan drangs/ de la dbang bskur dri ma dag rnam snang gis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod gtor bshams pa mngon rtogs ltar bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs byas la oṃ pri thi wi de wi sa pa ri wā ra bh+yo ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil dang nyes spyod rol mo rnams kyis mchod/ bh+yo zhes pa'i mjug tu a kā ro btags pas gtor ma phul/ lag pa g.yas pas spos dang g.yon dril bu thogs te/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sbyang ba'i tshul dang khyad par dang*// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis| |ji ltar bdud kyi dpung bcoms pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ / pham par bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ gnang ba byin nas sa'i lha mo nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam mo/ gsum pa bde gshegs las bslang ba ni/

mchod gtor sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la phyag mchod byas nas/ sgrub thabs ltar gtor ma phul nas spyod lam sdams| dgongs shig dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis| |sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa dang/ /slob ma rnams la phan don du// dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bri bar bgyi/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ grub na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg phul bas mnyes te gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ skabs 'di dag tu bgegs kyi mtshan ma byung na drag po'i sbyin bsreg bya zhing slob ma bsrung ba'i don du zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg kyang bya'o/ / gsum pa ni/ de nas las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i dri chu dang/ yungs kar dang chu dang thal bas sa phyogs der g.yas bskor gyis gtor zhing de bzla bar bya ba ni rdzas kyis sbyang ba'o/ /de nas sa rko ba la sogs ba'i las dang bya bas sbyang ba la/ lto 'phye brtag dgos shing*/ de yang rje rigs kyi klu rgyal mtha' yas/ ming gzhan lto 'phye zhes bya ba stod lha'i lus can gdengs ka dang ldan zhing smad sbrul mjug tu yod pa/ lus tshad srid du rang mtho bcu dang zheng du rang mtho gang yod pa zhig gzhogs g.yon 'og tu bcug lag pa g.yon pas 'gram pa g.yon pa rten zhing g.yas pas rin po che'i me tog stag zur g.yas kyi steng du bzung ba zhig ston dang dgun dang dpyid dang dbyar rnams kyi zla ba gsum shar lho nub byang du mgo bstan nas zhag re la rang gi lus kyi zheng gang gi dgu cha re mgo bos mdun dang*| mjug ma rgyab tu bgrod cing lo re la sa yi dkyil 'khor 'khor ba zhig yod pa'i mgo dang mjug ma dang rgyab rnams su rkos na rim pa bzhin pha ma 'chi ba dang*/ nor 'dzad pa dang rang nyid 'chi ba sogs kyi nyes dmigs yong la/

mchan khung g.yon pa'i thad kyi mdun du rkos na chos dang nor la sogs pa'i 'dod don 'phel zhing 'grub par bshad pas rko ba'i dmigs legs par btsal ba ni gal che'o/ / de yang 'di'i man ngag thun mong min pa ni/ sa der ji tsam 'dod pa yis/ /tshangs zur dpon slob rdo rje yi/ /'gros kyis phyogs 'tshams ma 'chol bar/ /btab nas zlum po'i thig gis skor/ /zlum thig de yi phyogs bzhi po/ /re re'ang gsum gsum bya rjes bya/ /ston ra yin na shar phyogs kyi/ /dbang ldan ngos kyi bya rjes nas| |bden bral zur thig zlum skor dang*/ /phrad pa'i bar du thig ring gdab/ / de bzhin nub phyogs me 'tshams la/ /nye ba'i de nas dbang ldan gyi/ /de yi bar la'ang de bzhin te/ /thig ring gnyis kyi bar de yang*/ /sum cu cha ru bgo bar bya// tshes gcig yin na lus kyi stod/ /shar mthas dbang ldan cha gcig dang*/ /mjug ma'i nub mtha' bdain bral gyi/ /cha gcig non nas lus kyi lhag /rim bzhin byang dang lho ru khyab/ /de tshe 'chan khung thad so nas/ /cha phran gnyis pa nas bgrang pa'i| |phyed dang lnga ni dor ba yi/ /thig de dum bu bcu ru bgo /dbang ldan phyogs nas bcu gsum cha/ /dor nas bcu cha gcig dang ni/ /zheng du cha phran phyed dang lngar/ /rko ru rung ba'i sa dmigs yin/ /de bzhin tshes gnyis yin na ni/ /cha phran gsum pa nas bgrang pa'i/ /phyed dang lnga sogs rigs pa sgre/ /zla ba gzhan la'ang de bzhin no/ /'on kyang lto 'phye legs nyal du/ /yong ba mkhas pas rtogs par bya/ /zhes pa'i don nyid du rtogs nas 'jug pa bde zhing nor 'khrul med par lag len du bya ba'i sa phyogs re mig gis bkang nas mgo bo 'khrug tu gzhug par mi bya'o/ de ltar sa dmigs rnyed pa na rko mkhan bgegs mthar byed dang rtog tse rdo rje rtse gcig par bsgaums nas shar ram byang gi phyogs su kha ltas nas rko ru bzhug cing*/ khaṃ pa lnga tshun la sa ro/

/rdo bar bcas na rlung chen po/ /rus par bcas na zug zer 'byung/ /gyo dum bcas na lkugs pa nyid/ /phub ma sol bar ldan na rims/ /skra dang rtsa ba shing sogs bcas/ /nye bar 'tshe ba phra mo 'byung*/ / zhes bshad pas de rnams byung na dor nas/ pus nub tsam du brkos te/ zhi ba la dkar po la sogs pa las dang mthun pa'i sa dri bzang kyi chu dang sman dang 'bru dang rin po che lnga la sogs pa la yi ge gsum bzlas pa dang bcas te khung bu bgang zhing mthas par bcags pa'i stegs bu mdzes par bya ste de lta bu ni las dang bya bas sbyang ba'o/ /de nas las mi kun gyis sa rko ba la sogs pa byas nas khung bu bkang ba'i stegs bu de nang du tshud pa'i khang rtsegs sgo bzhi pa phyogs re nas skar khung dra ba can dang rta babs kyis bskor ba rtsig par bya ba ni khang rtsegs kyi nang du chud pas sbyang ba'o/ /de nas de'i phyi nang du gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan sna tshogs dang bla re dang rnga yab dang me tog gi chun 'phyang dang*/ rin po che'i tog dang pi wang dang dril bu la sogs pas mdzes par bya ba ni/ rgyan dang mchod rdzas kyis sbyang ba'o/ /de nas 'dir dngos su gsungs pa'i bdag bskyed bsdus pa la ye shes pa bcug dbang bskur rgyas btab nas bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags bzlas pas bgegs tshar bcad par bsam pa ni ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyang ba'o/ /de nas rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal gyis lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sa la reg nas/ oṃ bh+ruṃ baṃ/ sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur oṃ hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ me di na badz+rir bha wa badz+ra ban+da hūm̐/ sa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bcings te brtan par 'gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje khro bos bgegs rnams bcom/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sho dha sho dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje gsum gyis sa'i nyes skyon sbyangs par gyur/

zhes bsam zhing brjod pa ni/ sngags kyis sbyangs pa'o/ /de nas sa de ba byung lnga dang dri bzang gis byug cing dbus su dri'i thig le me tog gi tshom bu dang bcas pa byas pa'i steng du nam mkha'i sa lha/ oṃ pri thī wi di wi ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs pa la sngar bzhin mchod gtor gsol gdab byas nas gnang ba byin te de nyid du thim par bsam pa ni sa lhas byin gyis brlabs pas sbyang ba'o/ /de nas sa lha la sogs pa'i sna tshogs pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du ro gcig par gyur zhes brjod cing legs par bsam pa ni bla na med pa'i sbyang ba ste de ltar na rdzas dang bya ba khang brtsegs rgyan ting 'dzin sngags dang sa lha dang bla na med dang sbyangs pa brgyad/ 'di dag ni dkyil 'khor khang pa dang sa stegs byed pa'i dbang du byas la/ mchod rten dang lha khang la sogs pa bzhengs na'ang blang ba gsum dang sbyang ba brgyad po 'di bzhin du bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor khang pa sngar nas byas pa'i sa la sogs par sa stegs gsar du byed na'ang 'di dag bya zhing*| de la ni brkos pa'i sa de nas nang du khyer te stegs la 'bru sman sogs gzhug go /sa stegs kyang mi byed pa'i khang bzang sogs su ni bya ba dang khang brtsegs las gzhan rnams bya ste sa sbyang ba'i cho ga'o/ / bzhi pa la gsum/ bdag bskyed bsgoms nas nga rgyal bzung ba/ / gsol ba btab nas dkyil 'khor 'degs pa/ /bskor zhing bka' bgos nas stang stabs bya'o/ /dang po ni rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su rgyan gos gsar pa dang ldan pas kha shar du phyogs te| bzlas pa'i bar gyi bdag bskyed rdzogs par sgoms nas/ dril bu bsil zhing snyems pa dang bcas pas/ bdag ni rang nyid rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag rang nyid/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che/ /bdag ni stobs chen rdo rje can/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal| |bdag ni phyag na rdo rje brtan/

/ bdag ni bdag po rdo rje che/ /byin gyis brlabs pa mi 'dor ro/ /zhes brjod cing de'i don la nga rgyal brtan par bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ sgo'i slob dpon du 'os pa bzhi'am med na gcig gis phyogs so sor song te'am/ de'ang med na rang gi mos pas mchod pa bshams pa byin gyis brlabs te/ shar nas rang nyid rnam snang dkar po zhes pa nas/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i stang stabs dang*/ spro zhing shes nas rdo rje'i gar stabs kyang rgyas par bya la/ phreng bar 'byung ba bzhin kha sbyor bcu drug kyang bya'o/ / lnga pa ni/ seng ldeng gyi phur bu stong*/ bgegs mthar byed lta bu smad gsal shing zur gsum pa'i dbyibs can la/ tsan+dan dmar pos byugs/ srad bu dmar pos dkris/ me tog gi phreng ba btags la/ bsang sbyang byas nas bgegs mthar byed du skad cig gis bskyed/ gnas gsum du yig 'bru gsum gyi hūṃ las 'od 'phros ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de'i mig gnyis su k+shiṃ k+shiṃ rna ba gnyis su dz+riṃ dz+riṃ/ sna bug gnyis su khaṃ khaṃ/ lce la gaṃ dpral bar kaṃ lte bar saṃ/ slar yang hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis dbang lha spyan drangs pas dbang bskur dri ma dag mi skyod pas dbu brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje phur bu me rab tu 'bar bar bsams pa lag pa g.yon du bzung zhing*/ g.yas su tho ba me rab tu 'bar ba bzung bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing bzung*/ de gnyis med na de ltar bsgoms la/ rang gi thugs ka nas/ spros pa'i 'od zer gyis brgya byin la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bkug pa'i spyi bor phur bu zug oṃ gha gha gha ta ya gha ta ya sarba duṣ+tān phaṭa phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ra ādzñā pa ya ti sarba bigh+nan kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

ces brjod cing phur bu dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su btab pas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phug ste gser gyi sa gzhi la sprags pas sgo gsum 'od gsal du thim par gyur ba'i phur bu las 'od zer rnon po phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'gro ba thams cad bgegs dang bral bar gyur cing*/ sa gzhi'i phyi rol du hūṃ las rdo rje'i ra ba dang*/ paṃ las rdo rje'i gur gyis skor ba'i phyi nas laṃ las dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor zur bzhi pa ser pos phyogs dang raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum pa dmar pos mtshams rnams bcings par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam mo/ /'dir phur bu dbus su 'debs par gzhung kun las bshad pas phur bu gcig zhes brjod cing bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ rang nyid gtso bo las bye ba'i rdo rje hūṃ mdzad sku mdog sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya thugs kar bcing pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ khro bo'i nyi mas thams cad dang ldan pa'i mig g.yas pa maṃ las nyi ma/ g.yon pa ṭa las zla ba mig 'bras hūṃ las dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ zhes brjaud cing*| nga rgyal drag tu byas nas rab tu gdangs pa'i rdo rje'i lta bas g.yon skor du bltas pas bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ g.yas skor du bltas pas ra gur dang mtshams bcings par bsams la/ ngag tu kro dha dṛṣ+ti hī/ lan gnyis dang*/ mig 'bras kyi rdo rje las khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bgegs thams cad tshar bcad cing rdo rje'i ra ba dang gur gyis bskor ba'i phyogs mtshams thams cad bcings par gyur zhes brjod do/ /de nas rang gi rkang mthil gnyis su a las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar ba re res mtshan par gyur/

hūṃ zhes brjod cing bsams nas dbang ldan mtshams su song nas sna tshogs rdo rje rtse lnga pa'am rtse gsum pa'am rtse gcig pa la sogs pa'i 'gros kyis dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la bskor ba gcig byas te/ dbang ldan nas kha nang du phyogs pas/ stong nyid snying rje'i ngang nas khro bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas hūṃ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ / bgegs kyi tshogs rnams nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor ba/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /lus gsum las byung bags bya ste/ /gal te bdag bsgo las 'das na/ /'jig par 'gyur ba gdon mi za| |zhes lan gsum nga ro drag pos brjod/ rol mo drag tu bya zhing gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab bo/ /de nas bgegs dang bral ba'i snyems pa dang ldan pas/ rdo rje'i 'gros kyis skor zhing shar lho nub byang g.yas brkyangs g.yon brkyangs sa ga zlum po la sogs pa'i stang bar 'di ma dpe shog bu brgyad pa'i rgyab dang dgu pa'i mdun ngos ma tshang bcings par gyur/ de nas mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byas nas rgyas bsdus ji lta'i rigs pas dbul zhing bstod/ bdud rtsi myang pa'i bar du bya'o/ /'dir dam tshig pa bskyeng pa dang skye mched byin rlabs sogs dang*/ spro ba bskyed cing snyan mnan pa sogs kyang rang gzhung du mi 'byung bas bzhag go /bsod snyoms pas skabs 'dir gsol gdab byas kyang rtsa 'grel dang phreng bar bum pa sta gon gyi mjug du bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rgyu rin po che las byas shing dbyibs lto ba che ba mchu 'phyang ba mgrin pa ring ba zhabs zhum zhing rtsa ba dang nag nog med pa'i lha bum bcu dgu las bum dang bcas pa'am/ med na gtso bo la de'i rig pa dang bcas pa lnga/ yum bzhi la bzhi/ las bum ste bcu/ de yang med na rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis rnam pa rang bzhin dkar por yod na des chogamed na tsan+da dkar po dang sbyar ba'i sa dkar gyis byug gtso bo'am rnam rgyal la chos 'byung gi dbus su sna tshogs pa'i pad zla la gnas pa'i gtso bo'i phyag mtshan/

gzhan rnams la'ang chos 'byung med pa'i so so'i gdan la so so'i phyag mtshan/ las bum la bgegs mthar byed kyi phyag mtshan/ de dang rnam rgyal gnyis las med na rnam rgyal la gtso bo'i phyag mtshan gyi 'og dang phyogs gzhan gsum rnams su rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan lhag ma rnams gur gum sogs kyis bri/ ras dkar pos mgrin pa dkri zhing chu gtsang ma srog chags med pas sum gnyis tsam bgang/ til/ nas/ gro/

mon sran/ 'bras| so ba ste 'bru lnga/ bṛ ha ti/ kan+ta ka ri dan+ḍa ud pa la gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po/ ha sa de ba ste sman lnga/ gser dngul mu tig byi ru mu men te rin po che lnga| dri bzang kyi chu rnams bluga'abras bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan la/ rnam rgyal gyi steng du bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa'i dri bzang kyi chus bkang ba'i dung chos/ de'i steng du rdo rje la me tog gi phreng ba btags pa rnams bzhag bum pa rnams phyogs ma 'chol bar bkod/ gnyis las med na/ 'dir slob dpon bsod snyoms pas rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i g.yas su 'jog par gsungs shing mchod yul gyi gtso bo yin pas kha tshur lta'i g.yas dang de'i g.yon du las bum bzhag par bya ste/ de bya ba mang bas rnal 'byor pa'i lag pa g.yas dang nye bar 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar bum bskyed kyi mchod pa'i mgo yang rnam rgyal gyi ngos la bstan te legs par bshams zhing*/ bum pa las mi ring bar gtor ma yang bsham mo/ /de nas las thams cad pas bsang*/ swa bha was sbyangs stong ba'i ngang las paṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa lto ba che ba la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gyur pa rnams kyi nang du oṃ tap+te tap+te ma hā tap+te sā hā/ lha'i chu bo dal 'bab dang bum pa'i chu rnams dbyer med par gyur/ de rnams kyi nang dang mtshan ma so so'i gnas su/ rang rang gi gdan gyi steng du rang gi sa bon las byung ba'i rang rang gi phyag mtshan sa bon so sos mtshan pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las sku yongs su rdzogs pa rnams su gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi bum pa'i nang dang mtshan ma'i gnas su 'jam pa'i rdo rje sogs nas/ phyi'i byang gi bum pa'i nang dang mtshan ma'i gnas su bgegs mthar byed sogs dang*/ las bum gyi nang dang mtshan ma'i gnas su yang bgegs mthar byed rnams sku mdog phyag mtshan bsgrub thabs ltar bskyed ba'am/

bum pa bcu las med na rigs lnga dang yum bzhi bgegs mthar byed rnams bskyed/ gnyis las med na/ dbyer med par gyur/ ces pa'i rjes la/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad ma'i gdan bcu dgu/ dbus kyi shar las gzhan pa'i phyogs gsum dang phyi'i phyogs bzhir nyi ma dang gzhan rnams su zla ba'i gdan/ de rnams kyi steng du rang rang gi sa bon zhes sogs nas yongs su rdzogs pa rnams su gyur pa ni/ dbus su 'jam dpal rdo rje zhes sogs nas phyi'i byang du bgegs mthar byed zhes sogs dang*/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i mtshan ma lnga'i gnas su sna tshogs pad ma'i gdan re re/ shar gyi steng 'og gnyis su zla ba/ gzhan gsum du nyi ma/ de rnams kyi steng du rang rang gis sa bon zhes pa nas yongs su rdzogs pa rnams su gyur pa ni/ shar gyi steng du 'jam pa'i rdo rje| de'i 'og tu rnam snang*/ lhor rin 'byung*/ nub du 'od dpag med*/ byang du don grub sogs dang*/ las bum gyi nang dang mtshan ma'i gnas su sna tshogs pad nyi la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las bgegs mthar byed rnams bskyed/ de rnams kyi mig gnyis su zhes sogs mngon rtogs ltar rgyas pa'am| bsdu na mig gnyis su k+shiṃ k+shiṃ dkar po/ rna ba gnyis su dz+riṃ dz+riṃ nag po/ sna bug gnyis su khaṃ khaṃ ser po/ lce la gaṃ dmar po/ dpral bar kaṃ ljang khu/ lte bar saṃ dkar po/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ nag po| thugs ka'i hūm̐ las rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rgyal ba yab yum zhes sogs nas/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur zhes mngon rtogs ltar brjod cing bsam/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba rnams rgyas bsdus gang rung byas la|

oṃ badz+ra amṛ ta u da ka hūm̐/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun bdun bzlas te| dung chos kyi chu ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas pa'i rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas lag pa g.yon pas rdo rje la btags pa'i gzungs thag me tog dang bcas te bzung la/ gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ gzhan rnams la nyi shu rtsa re re dang*/ bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad phreng sngags dang bcas pa bzlas pa'i mthar gtso bo'i sngags dang hūm̐ lan bdun bzlas pa'i dung chos gyi chus mchod bstod dang las thams cad bzlas pa'i me tog dkar po gsum bum par blug slar yang oṃ sa rba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pi nas shap+da'i bar gyis mchod/ las bum gyi kha rgyan chu dang bcas pas bum pa la bsang te ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol zhes phrin las bcol/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas| bum bskyed kyis ljags la zhes sogs kyi ljags byin gyis brlabs nas sgrubs thabs ltar gtor ma phul/ yi ge brgya pa brjod pa'i rjes su/ bum pa la reg te/ mi skyod rdo rje ye shes sogs/ ma dpe'i shog grangs bcu gcig pa'i sngon ldeb mi 'dug lnga'i bar du zung du ma gyur pa rnams sam/ snod dang ldan na grangs kyi nges pa med pa yang rung ste/ de rnams dkyil 'khor yol bas sgribs pa'i phyi rol du bzhag te sems rtse gcig pas nyan du bcug la/ 'dir dbang bskur don du gnyer ba la ched du gnyer bya'i kun slong gsum te/ la la 'di yi don grub phyir/ /gsang sngags dkyil 'khor 'jug par byed/ /ces pa tshe 'di'i bden 'bras 'dod pa dang| bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /ces pa tshe phyi ma'i mngon mtho tsam 'dod pa dang*/ gzhan dag 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer/ /zhes pa 'jig rten las gzhan pa sangs rgyas 'dod pa gsum las bsam pa phyi ma bskyed dgos te/

'jig rten pha rol don gnyer ba'i/ /dad pa mang du byed pa yi/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod mi bya/ /tshe 'di 'dod par gyur pa la| |'jig rten pha rol 'bras mi 'byung*/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer skyes/ / 'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu rgyas/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /zhes brjod/ slob ma rnams me'i dkyil 'khor rab tu 'bar ba'i steng na gnas pa'i snying khar yang raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor 'bar bas sdig sgrib thams cad dang tha mal gyi phung po bsregs nas/ rnam shes oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum du gnas pa rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis bkugs nas zhal du zhugs rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa der skad cig gis sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor phyi nang du bcug nas chos 'byung gi phyag rgya'i 'od kyis reg pa tsam gyis 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las gtso bor bskyed/ slar yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te rang gi lus la zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas 'thon pas dbang bskur te/ pad ma nas 'thon par rang gnas su 'khod par bsam mo/ / gnyis pa ni phyag dang maṇ+ḍal dang yon phul la/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsaul/ / byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsaul/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su bcug la/ slob ma gcig gtso bor byas nas khyod ni tshul chen snod yin pas/ /bu tshur shog cig theg chen po'i/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams|

|rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ / gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa/ /gang gi shākya seng ge sogs/ /mchog rnams kyis kyang bdud kyi sde/ /mi zad chen po stobs chen bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/ /'khor lo skor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig/ces pa'i don bshad de sngags la mos pa brtan po 'dzin du gzhug gsum pa ni/ de nas gang zhig thogs med srid pa'i chu klung du/ /zhes sogs kyi rgyun bshags byed du 'jug pa spro zhing long yod na bya zhing*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg chen dang thun mong ba'i dam tshig dang sdom pa mtha' dag rdzogs byang gi bar du 'dzin pa'i bsam pa bskyed du bcug nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yid rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ /zhes don dran bzhin pas lan gsum rjes bzlos byed du bzhugs/ las thams cad pas bsrung zhing rang gi lag pa g.yas pa rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dri bzang gi chus slob ma'i snying khar reg cing hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po/ mgrin par reg nas āḥzhes pas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ dpral bar reg nas oṃ zhes brjod pas 'khor lo dkar po brtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ de bzhin du yas mar reg cing brjod pas mig gsum las 'od zer 'phros nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum spyan drangs te yi ge gsum la thims/ yang mas yar reg cing brjod pas slob ma'i sgo gsum dang de rnams dbyer med du gyur par bsam la/ mchod pa me tog mchod yon dri mchog mar me rnams las thams cad pas bsang zhing yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/

rang rang gi spyi bo nas mdun du dang snying kha dang mig sngar rnams su 'bul ba'am/ yang na nyer spyod lnga tshang mar 'bul te dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par/ /mchod pa kun dang khyod ldan pas| |dus rnams kun tu bde bar mnos/ /zhes brjod do/ / bzhi pa ni/ rang gi mdun du dri bzang kyi maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa 'dom gru bzhi pa tsam byas la/ a shwad tha'am u dum wa ra la sogs pa'i sor bcu gnyis drang zhing rma dang srog chags dang des zos pa'i rjes med pa'i rtse mor me tog gis bcings pa las thams cad pa bzlas kyi dri bzang gi chus byugs pa slob ma kha shar byang du bltas pa'i snyims par byin la/ des kyang*/ cang mi smra ba'am/ badz+ra ha sa ha/ zhes brjod cing rtse mo nas sos 'cha' ba'i tshul byas nas dri'i maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du ltos pa med par dor bas rtse mo shar lho nub byang steng 'og tu bstan na/ rgyas pa drag po dbang zhi ba rig 'dzin sa 'og rnams 'grub cing phyi rol tu lhung na dngos grub med do zhes brjod do/ /de ni ltas brtag pa'o/ /de nas nang gi nyes skyon sbyang ba'i phyir du las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i dri chus oṃ hriḥsu bi shud+dha sarba pā paṃ ne tse a s+ya bi sho d+dha ya sarba bi kalpan a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes bzlas zhing*/ khyod la byin nas 'thung du bcug la bkra shis rmi lam mi 'khrul pa'i ched du rtsa ku sha ma nyams pa'i gsar pa che chung gnyis hūm̐ dang dhīḥlas byung bar bsam zhing de gnyis brjod pas rim pa bzhin stan dang rngas kyi don du thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du byin/ de nas bar chad bsrung ba'i don du srad bu dmar po slob ma'i lus tshad dang ldan pa gsum sgril byas las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum dang de'i dpung pa g.yas la/ las thams cad pa bzlas la sbyin zhes bshad na'ang 'gyur gyi skyon yin pa 'dra bas g.yon du brtags na rab byung la gzhan gyis mi mthong ba la sogs pa'i dgos pa yod cing gzhan dang mthun no/

/lnga pa ni/ 'jig rten na ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin| |rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*/ / gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par 'gyur/ /skal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag/ thams cad zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang zhig spyod pa'i mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro thams cad gcod par 'gyur| |bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ / gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pas/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin par/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod gnas te/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ / lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang 'byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don bshad la spro ba bskyed/ de nas ku sha che chung stan dang rngas su byas pa'i mal dkyil 'khor ram bla ma la mgo bstan par de dag la dad gus kyis sems rtse gcig pas nyol la/ tho rangs lhas ston pa'i rmi lam gang mthong ba nga la smos shig ces bsgo'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ slob ma rig pa'i dbang lnga mthar rten dang bcas pa tsam 'dod pa la snga mas 'grub la/ /dbang de las lhag pa 'dod pa'i slob ma khyad par can yin na/ slob dpon gyi zhabs la gtugs pa'i phyag byas dbu la me tog gtor zhing slob ma'i lag tu me tog thogs nas grub na rgyun bshags bya zhing*/

maṇ+ḍal phul la thal mo sbyar te/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*/ /dam pa bdag la bstsal nas ni/ /mgon po dkyil 'khor lha rnams kyis/ /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon bgyi| |zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su bcug la/ slob ma gtso bo'i ming bcug ste/ che ge zhes bya khyod nyid ni/ /gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag pa'i/ / gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ /zhes dris la slob mas khyod kyi gnas su bdag bcug pas lan gdab/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs te rdor dril 'dzin pas/ che ge zhes bya 'di nyid ni| |byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin cing*/ /gsang ba'i dam tshig sdom gnas pas| |dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /zhes lha la gsol ba btab nas| slob ma la sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig brtan par gyur pa'o| |rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dag /blo chen gyis ni bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun mnyam par/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bya/ /'dir ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i| |dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ / zang zing chos dang mi 'jigs byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /'di ni rin chen rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa rab tu bshad/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum| |dam chos khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /'dir ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ / dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya/

/zhes brjod de sdom pa bsgrags la/ slob mas/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ /de ltar bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yi/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /zhes pa nas sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod| |zhes pa'i bar gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin don dran bzhin pas lan gsum rjes bzlos byed du bcug cing sdom pa'i mig phyed pa dang*/ len 'dod khyad par can bskyed pa dang brjod pa gsum pa'i sum gnyis tsam rdzogs pa'i dus su skye ba'i thob dus shes pa la sogs pa brda legs par 'phrod par byas te phog pas slob dpon rtsa ltung dang mi ldan na skabs 'dir skye la/ ldan na sang bdag 'jug gis bsos pas dngos gzhi'i dus su skye'o/ /'dir shān+ti pa dang bod kyi pan+ṭi tas rtse mo nas 'byung ba'i rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sdom pa sgrag bzung thun mong min pa rnams mdzad pa ni/ rgyud sde gong ma gnyis rtsa ltung mi gcig par rang nyid bzhed pa'i khas blangs dang yang 'gal zhing rigs pa dang yang 'gal te gzhan du bshad zin to/ / de nas rmi lam rtog du bzhug cing*/ rang gis kyang dri'i dkyil 'khor la mchod pa byas nas de nyid kyi mthar ram gzhan du nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis nyal la rmi lam brtag nang par snga bar langs te rmi lam dri zhing byang chub kyi shing drung du 'gro ba dang chos bshad pa sogs rmi na bzang*/ spre'u dang ma he mthong ba dang gcan gzan gyis rmugs pa dang lus la 'bru mar gyis byugs pa sogs rmi na ngan pas/ bzang na spro ba bskyed cing*/ ngan na slob dpon gyis las thams cad pa bzla zhing*/ slob ma la'ang de'i bsgom bzlas byin nas bzla ba dang rmi lam rang bzhin med par shes pas bzlog par bya'o/ / gsum pa dngos gzhi la gsum/

dkyil 'khor bri zhing brgyan pa/ sgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po la bri ba dang*/ brgyan pa'o// dang po la thig gis dang tshon gyis bri ba'o/ /dang po la 'dir bod kyi mkhas pa dag ye thig dang por mdzad pa ni/ 'di'i dkyil chog rtsa 'grel du/ thig nam mkhar bteg nas de bzhin du sa la 'debs par gsungs pa ni ye thig nyid kyi dbang du byas par gsal bas/ las thig dngos su ma gsungs kyang 'di'i rjes 'brangs bsod snyoms pa dang a bha yas las thig sngon la btab nas de ye thig gis byin gyis brlob par bshad pa bzhin du rgya gar gyi mkhas pa du ma mgrin gcig tu bzhed pa dang 'gal zhing rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang sdom 'byung gi dgongs par bzhed pa'ang mkhas pa gzhan gyis bkag pa ltar yin pas las thig dang por gdab par bya'o/ /des na gzhon nu mas bkal ba'am dpa' bo'i rin gyis nyos pa'am dam tshig can gyis bkal ba yang rung ste/ sboms su dkyil 'khor ji tsam byed pa'i sgo'i nyi shu cha dang srid du dpon slob gnyis kyis lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo bzhi la bskor ba gcig byas nas bzung ba'i lhag ma la rta babs sgo tshad gcig ma byed na dkyil 'khor ces pa rtsa thig gi nyis 'gyur dang gsum ma byed na dkyil 'khor 'khor bcas mda' yab kyi nyis 'gyur rtsa thig khru gang pa'i dbang du byas na khru do'am bzhi'i tshad dang ldan pa gsum sgril du byas pa'i las thig dang*/ ye thig lnga tshan sta gon byas dang por las thig bdung rtsi dang dri bzang gi chus cung zad sher ba las thams cad pas bsangs/ shū n+ya tās sbyangs bgegs mthar byed du bskyed| skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs ye shes pa bcug /dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ mchod de zhu ba las byung ba'i thig skud du gyur pa 'bras phyai dang dri bzang btab pa'i thig gi tshal dang sbags/ rang nyid gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas dri'i dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod byas nas sngar gyi sngags rgyas nam mkhar bteg nas ny-i zla kha sbyar gyi dbus su bzhugs par gyur/

oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kṛ ta hūṃ zhes pas bsrungs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa la oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni hūṃ zhes brjod cing dri bzang gi chus gtor/ mtha' la me tog bkram la/ slob ma bgegs mthar byed du gsal ba dang lhan cig slob dpon nub nas shar du dang slob ma de la mngon du phyogs pas 'greng ste/ slob dpon gyi lte ba'i 'thad sor lag pa g.yon pas bzung zhing yi ge dzaḥlan gsum brjod bzhin pas slob ma la gtad la nges kyang de brjod cing blangs tai sne mo g.yon pas bzungs la/ phyogs cung zad kyang ma g.yo bar byas nas/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing shar nub kyi thig gdab bo/ /de nas rtsa thig khru gang pa byed na/ drang po'i tshangs thig dbus nas ni/ /mtho gang gis skor zlum po cig/de dang tshangs thig phrad pa nas| |mtho gang dang ni sor lngas skor/ /shar nub zlum po gnyis su gyur/ /nya steng tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab/ /de dang nang gi zlum thig gnyis/ /'dzom pa'i sa nas snga ma bzhin/ /bskor ba'i lho byang zlum po gnyis/ /dbus nas zur thig nya yi bar/ /phyogs tshad zur thig nya nas phyir/ /mtshan ma byas te zur thig gdab| |zur thig rtse nas zur thig rtser/ /mda' yab thig ni gdab par bya/ / khru gang la sogs rtsa thig gi/ dbus su brgyad cha phyid pa sgo/ /de yi bzhi cha cha chung ste| |rtsa ba'i phyi rol gcig dang gnyis/ /gcig gnyis gcig dang gcig gi mthar| |thig drug zur nas ngos su ste/ /tshangs pas rim gis ring bar ni/ /cha chung gsum du dang po'i thig/gnyis thig cha chung gnyis rtser reg

/cha chung brgyad du gsum stegs bu'i/ /thig las drang po'i thig bzhi ste/ /gsum ni cha chung lnga bzhi pa/ /cha chung bzhi ste dang po ni/ /ngos thig rtse mor yang dag reg / gsum ni cha chung re re'i bar/ /bzhi pa'i rtse nas ngos su thig /cha chung bcu dang ldan pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i rtse nas byung ba'i thig /cha chung bzhi pa ngos steng du/ /cha chung gnyis gnyis thad kar ni/ /cha chung brgyad de gsum 'khyog pa/ /ka ba'i rtse nas phyi ngos su/ /cha chung re re'i dor bar thig /bcu gcig 'di la lnga pa dang*/ / bdun pa cha chung phyed dang gnyis/ /yang na gsum pa bdun pa dang/ /dgu pa cha chung re re'o| |bzhi pa drug pa bcu pa rnams/ /so sor cha chung phyed phyed do/ /lnga ni cha chung phyed dang gnyis/ /de la phyogs gnyis su ni rgyar/ /tshangs pa'i g.yas dang g.yon nas ni/ /cha chung phyed bcas mda' yi mthar/ /snam bu cha chung phyed dang gsum| |thig ni cha chung phyed dang bzhi/ /cha chung drug mthar gnyis pa dang*/ / gsum pa cha chung gsum pa'o/ /cha chung bzhi mthar bzhi pa ni/ /cha chung lnga ste mda' phyed bcas/ /gsum de nas ni phyed dang lnga/ /gsum nas drug pa cha chung lnga/ /bzhi ni cha chung bdun rnams te/ /thig bcu gcig pa cha chung lnga/ /snam bu lnga pa'i steng gi ni| |ngos su cha chung phyed dang bzhi/ /bdun pa'i 'og la cha chung gsum/ /steng ni cha chung drug steng su/ /snam bu rnam mthar son pa'i thig/gzhan gyi mtha' dang lhan cig ste/ /skyog po gcig go de nang du'ang*/ /cha chung phyed nas de bzhin gzhan/ /de phyir cha chung rig byed mthar/ /thig zlum de nas gnyis yin te/ /cha chung gnyis gnyis dor bar ro/ /bzhi dor bar ni zlum po gzhan/ /zhes pa phyi thig dang*/ tshangs las cha chung brgyad mthar dang*/ /bdun pa'i mtha' ru zlum po'i thig / de nas yang dag drangs nas ni/ /phyogs gzhan thig gi 'tshams song ba'i/ /thig gnyis rim bzhin tshangs pa'i mthar/ /cha chung gnyis gsum dor bar ro/

/thig zlum thig las phyi ngos su/ /cha chung dor bar zlum po'i thig /de nas cha chung gsum dor nas/ /zur thig bar du gnas pa'i thig /kun tu son pa'i tshangs thig dang*// re mig snam bu'i re kha dbyi/ /zhes pas nang gi thig gdab cing thig ro dbyi'o/ /de nas rwa'i thig ni 'di'i dgos kyi dkyil chog rnams su ma bshad kyang mi 'dod pa min te/ sgrub thabs kun bzang du/ pad+ma der ni sna tshogs rdo rje mdzes/ zhes sna tshogs pad+ma dang rdo rje gnyis ka gsal bar gsungs so/ /des na gzhan dag rwa thig gi tshul gzhan du 'dod pa ni/ 'di'i rwa'i rnam bzhag phreng bar bshad pa las gzhan ma byung ba dang 'gal bas phreng ba bzhin du bya zhing*/ de yang phreng bar rwa rnams ni cha phran bcu drug pa'o zhes pa la 'bru mnon lugs ci rigs yod pa las rang lugs thun mong min pa gzhan du shes par bya la/ 'dir phyis kyi mkhas pas mdzad pa'i thun mong ba tsam bshad na de'i tshul ni/ tshangs dang mda' yab phrad pa nas| |cha chung bzhi dang bzhi gsum ni/ /song bar cha chung dgu dang ni/ /bzhi chas g.yas g.yon phyi rwa skor/ /mda' yab tshad las cha chung ni/ /phyed bcas gsum nas thad kar g.yas/ /drug nas phyed bcas bcu gnyis kyis/ /g.yon skor g.yas pa de las bzlog/ces pa ltar bya'o/ de bzhin du rta babs kyi tshad dang*| |glang rgyab las sogs pa'ang phreng ba ji bzhin du rigs so/ /de nas dbus su phyin nas khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis rdor dril dkur bzung nas 'gying pa dang bcas pas lta stangs drag pos blta zhing*/ thar pa'i sgo'i gegs su gyur pa'i sgrib pa rnams dbyi bar bya'o/ /zhes brjod cing sgo nang gi rtsa thig bzhi dbyi'o/ /de ltar las thig 'debs pa na slob dpon gyi 'dug sa dang skor phyogs la sogs pa dngos su ma bshad mod kyi/ ye thig la bshad pa ltar byed na/ slob dpon nub dang lho ru gnas pas shar nub dang lho byang gi tshangs thig gnyis gdab cing*/

me nas byang du phyogs pas shar gyi rtsa thig dang*/ rlung nas lho ru phyogs pas nub kyi dang*| de nas shar du phyogs pas byang gi dang*/ slar yang me nas nub tu phyogs pas lho'i rtsa thig gdab/ bden bral nas dbang ldan du phyogs pas de gnyis kyi zur thig gdab cing*/ ngos thig lhag ma rnams kyang rtsa thig 'debs sa'i sdod lugs de nyid kyis gdab/ zlum thig 'debs pa'i tshe/ seng ldeng sogs kyi phur bu stod rtse lnga pa dang smad rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa can phur bu brdungs ba'i sngags kyis dbus su gtsugs la/ phyi'i zlum thig gi tshe slob dpon gyis bzung zhing slob mas bskor la/ nang gi bzlog nas thig skud gnyis lteb byas pa phur bu la btags nas dbang ldan nas bskor bar bya zhing*/ thams cad kyi tshe g.yas skor dang slob mas slob dpon la rgyab mi ston pa'i spyod lam gyis rdo rje'i 'gros byed pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis g.yon skyil dkrung dang g.yas kyis rkang mthil 'dzugs shing slob mas de las bzlog ste bya'o/ /de ltar las thig thebs pa na/ rang nyid gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas*/ sngar gyi skud pa lnga po gser la sogs pa rin po che'i snod lngar bzhag pa dang yungs dkar gyi phye ma dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga bsres pa'i dri bzang po'i tshon sna dkar ser dmar ljang sngo bas kha bsgyur la/ g.yon pa'i lag 'thil du mthe'u chung gi rtsa ba nas mthe bong gi rtsa ba'i bar du rim pa bzhin bkod pa'i srad bu rnams rim pa bzhin bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ las skyes pa'i rigs lnga'i rang bzhin ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ nam mkha'i rigs lnga'i thugs kar yang bh+ruṃ la sogs pa las byung ba'i ye shes kyi srad bu 'od kyi rang bzhin du bzhugs pa la*/ oṃ āḥ shā shā ta dang*/ rat+na saṃ bha wa dang*/ a mi tā bhā dang*/ a mo gha sid+dhi dang*/ a k+ṣo bh+ya rnams la| badz+ra sū traṃ me pra yats+tsha ma hā maṇ+ḍa la sū tra na ya hūm̐/

zhes pa btags ste gsol ba btab cing*/ rang gi mig g.yas g.yon dza dza las nyi ma dang zla ba 'od zer ser po can du gyur pa'i mig 'bras rab tu sgril zhing rdzi ma myur du 'degs pa'i 'bar ba'i lta stangs lcags kyu lta bu dang*/ oṃ dip+ta triṣ+ta.aṃ ku shi dzaḥzhes brjod pas/ nam mkha'i ye shes kyi srad bu rigs lnga'i thugs kar nas btang ba rnams lag pa'i thig skud la so sor thim par gyur/ de nas slob ma las thams cad par gsal ba dang lhan cig oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharma s+pha ra s+pha ra a nu pra biṣ+ta sarba dha rmaḥ ad+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ta sarba dharmaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing dang po lnga tshan so so dang der rting lhan cig tu bsgril ba bdud rtsi lnga dang dri bzang gi sbangs pa'i srad bu'i dbus su hūm̐ dang g.yas g.yon du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa gser gyi snod gtsang mar gnas pa la dri dang spos dang me tog gis mchod de reg la las thams cad pas bsrung ngo*/ /de nas rang gi mig g.yas pa ma las nyi ma dang g.yon pa ṭa las zla bar gyur pas thig skud la bltas la/ badz+ra driṣ+ta ma ṭa zhes brjod pas ye shes pa brtan par gnas pa byas la las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang yungs dkar dang dri bzang gi chus gtor zhing rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas reg pa ste/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra hūm̐ zhes brjod cing 'bru gsum brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gtso bo dang slob ma las thams cad par gsal ba'i mig g.yas g.yon dza dza las nyi zla ser po 'od zer can du gyur par mos nas gnyis kas rdor dril bzung te spyod lam dang slob ma'i lag tu gtod tshul las thig bzhin btad pa lte ba'i thad kar rdo rje khu tshur gyis bzung te/ rang gi g.yas pa'i mtheb 'dzub kyi se gol gyi sgra dang bcas pa'i thig skud nam mkhar btab pa'i thig gi sgra las/ sem can don du khyed rnams kyi/

/dus yin de phyir 'dir spyod cig /ces pas bskul nas nam mkha'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byon pa rnams thig skud la thim par gyur zhes brjod cing bsams la/ sngar gyi sdod tshul gyis sa la sdad nas shar nub kyi thig las thig 'debs pa'i sngags kyis btab pas/ ngo bo ye shes la rnam pa srad bu kha dog lnga pa re ye thig las chad nas las thig la thims par gyur zhes brjod cing*/ de ji lta ba bzhin du tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab/ rtsa thig la sogs pa nam mkhar 'debs pa'i skor ma gtogs snga ma bzhin dang*/ spyod lam la sogs pa ni las thig ji lta ba bzhin du bya'o/ /rtsa thig zur thig snga phyi ni phreng bar gzhan du bshad kyang tshul 'di rang gzhung rnams su gsal lo/ /de ltar las thig thebs tshad la ye thig btabs nas byin gyis brlabs te/ thebs pa na thig skud dang thig gnyis ka la mchod gtor lhan cig du phul nas badz+ra muḥ zhes pas ye thig gi ye shes pa nam mkha'i rigs lnga'i thugs kar gshegs/ srad bu sna lnga gnas ji ltar bar bzhag go /'di rnams kyi skabs su ltas ngan byung na dngos grub med/ /thig skud chad na bla ma 'chi/ /ring thung khyer na nad 'byung zhing*/ /phyogs 'khrul slob ma myos par gyur/ /zhes gsungs la/ spyir thig gnyis ka dang thig mtha' dag khyad par ye thig tshangs thig gnyis kyi skabs su skyon de rnams mi 'byung ba'i thabs dang phyogs thams cad mnyam pa nyid du mos pa la 'bad cing mtshan ma ngan na las thams cad pas bsrung ngo*/ / gnyis pa la tshon 'du bya ba/ de bgye pa/ phyag rgya dgod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rab rin po che lnga'am lcags lnga/ 'bring khams lnga/ tha ma so phag bsregs pa sogs las byas pa'i tshon rtsi dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba rnams rin po che'i snod so sor bzhag re re la lnga lnga tshang ba'i phyir du gzhan bzhi po cung zad bsre/ rdul tshon dang kha dog mthun pa'i dri bzang dang rin po che lnga dang yungs dkar gyi phye ma bsres pa rnams la rim pa bzhin bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūm̐ rnams bris la phyogs ma 'chol bar bzhag

bsang sbyangs byas la rdul tshon rnams la bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃkhaṃ hūm̐ rnams las byung ba'i rigs lnga'i rang bzhin ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ nam mkha'i rigs lnga'i zhes pa nas/ rang bzhin du bzhugs pa la/ rang gi mig g.yas g.yon dza dza zhes pa nas so sor thim par gyur/ ces pa'i bar du srad bu dang thig skud tshon rtsi zhes par sgyur ba thig gi skabs bzhin bya/ de nas rigs lnga'i bzlas sngags dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ rang gi mig g.yas pa ma las zhes pa nas/ ye shes pa brtan par gnas shing tshon rtsi gzi brjid 'bar bar gyur| tshon rnams la hi yig bris nas bden pa gang gis sems can rnams rdul tshon mang zhing sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can la chags pa dang rjes su chags pa'i bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cig ces brjod de spar la dri la sogs pas mchod do/ / gnyis pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs nas oṃ badz+ra be ga ā kra ma hūm̐ rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas ye shes kyi thig gi 'og tu zhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin la/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis las mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar byas pa phan tshun bsnol te/ skam pa'i phyag rgya dang hūm̐ zhes pas phur bu phyung ba lag pa'i rdo rje la thim par bsam zhing*/ de nas phur khung rtsig pa'i rim pa dang mthun pa'i rdul tshon gyis bkang la/ dril bu dkrol zhing*/ chos dbyings 'di ni dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /rang nyid 'jam dbyangs rgyal po ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /'khor lo'i nang na yang dag gnas/ /zhes don dran bzhin pas glu blang ngo*/ /de nas tshon sa/ mngon rtogs na gsal ba rnams ni de kho na ltar bya la/ de na mi gsal ba/ nang gi ling tshe dgu phyogs mdog dbus sngo ba/ ka ba nag po la rang rang gi mtshan ma can gdung zlum nag po rdo rje dkar po/

'od phreng sna lnga/ bum pa phyogs mdog rta babs kyi ka ba phyogs mdog de'i phyi dar dpyangs mdzes mtshon/ nang gi mun snam nag po rgyal mtshan brgyad ni rtse mor zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa drang zhing ldem pa'i dbyug pa la bcings pa'i dar lce gsum pa rlung gis bskyod pa'i tshul du gsum khugs 'khyog po'i sne mor seng ge dang ngang pa la sogs pas mtshan zhing dril chung gi lce la rnga yab btags pa/ ba dan brgyad ni de dang 'dra ba la srog chags kyi mtshan ma med pa dang*/ rta babs kyi glang rgyab phyogs mdog ser snam ser po/ shar bu sngar bzhin/ rin po che ni pha gu lta bu/ rmig pa ljang khu/ mun pa nag po wa raṇ+ḍa mdzes tshon/ mda' yab sngar bzhin gyi rtse mor cha chung gnyis pa'i 'khor lo dang ri dwags ser po ste 'khor lo sna tshogs pad zla la gnas pa/ phyi'i pad ma'i lte ba ljang ge sar ser ba/ 'dab ma mdzes tshon/ de'i gzhi dmar skya/ de'i phyi'i re kha dkar po/ rdor 'phreng gzhi nag po la rdo rje ser po'am dkar po/ de'i phyi'i re kha rdo rje'i mdog me ri kha dog lnga g.yas 'khyil rnams so/ /bod kyi mkhas pas/ tshon sa phreng ba nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin bkod pa ni/ gong du thig la rta babs kyi glang rgyab dang rwa la sogs pa tshul gzhan du bshad pa dang ma mthun mod kyi paṇ+ḍi ta'i bya ba mang pas nongs so/ /gzhan yang brjod par bya ba mang po snang yang tshig mang du dogs pas bzhag go / gsum pa ni/ gnas bcu dgur sna tshogs pad ma dang zla nyi mngon rtogs bzhin byas la/ sna tshogs pad ma ni phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma dmar/ me rlung gnyis ser/ bden bral ljang*/ dbang ldan sngo/ lte ba ljang*/ ge sar ser ba'o| |gdan de rnams kyi steng du lha sku lugs ma sogs kyi phyag rgya chen po 'god rgyu yod cing skye bo ma dad pa sogs kyi dgag bya med na dgod la/ phyag mtshan dgod na/ lha rnams kyi phyag mtshan dang po rnams rang rang gi gnas su 'god cing*/

sa bon 'god na'ang rang rang gis sa bon lañdza sogs su dgod par bya ste/ de gnyis gtso bo'i mgo nub dang gzhan rnams rang rang gi phyogs su bstan nas bri'o| |de ltar bris tshar ba dang*/ tshon la mchod gtor phul nas tshon lhag ma'i ye shes pa nam mkhar rigs lnga'i thugs kar gshegs nas lhag ma dben par bzhag go / gnyis pa ni/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' ba byung dang dri bzang gis byugs me tog bkram la/ bum pa rnams dkyil 'khor la g.yas skor du spos dang rol mos spyan drangs te/ gtso bum/ shar sgo nas kha yar lta'i g.yas su kha nang du phyogs pas bzhag la/ de'i g.yon du rnam snang/ spyan ma/ las bum rnams dang g.yas su gshin rje'i gshed/ chos dbyings rdo rje ma gzugs rdo rje ma rnams so/ / lho sgo'i g.yas g.yon du rin 'byung mā ma ki sgra rdo rje ma/ shes rab mthar byed/ nub sgo'i g.yas g.yon du 'od dpag med gos dkar mo/ /dri rdo rje ma/ pad ma mthar byed/ byang sgo'i g.yas g.yon du don grub sgrol ma ro dang reg bya rdo rje ma rnams gnyis gnyis me ri'i mthar 'god do/ /bum pa kun nas chu bsdus ba'i dung chos man 'ju lta bu'i steng du shar sgo'i thang du bzhag par shān+ti pas bshad la rnam rgyal gyi steng du bzhag pa bsod snyoms pas bshad do/ /phyogs bzhir stan mdzes pa'i steng du sher phyin/ sdong po bkod pa/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gser 'od dam pa rnams bzhugs shing klog tu'ang bzhug go /mchod pa rnams kyang bcu las mi nyung ba bkod pa mdzes par bsham/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang gos zung sogs kyang ji ltar 'byor pa mdzes shing yid 'phrog par byas la grwa bzhir bdug spos bzang po rtag tu 'thul ba'i spos phor dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dang dgos kyi chos skyong gi gtor ma dang dbang gi yo byad rnams kyang tshogs par bya'o/ / gnyis pa la sgrub pa dang mchod pa'o/

/dang po ni/ 'di'i dkyil chog rtsa 'grel las/ rang nyid rnal 'byor dang ldan pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar spyan drangs shar sgo'i thad du bzhugs pa'i phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad nas mchod de dgug zhug bcing mnyes tsam las ma gsungs la slob dpon bsod snyoms pas ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas phyag rgya dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras ye shes pa spyan drangs te lus la bzhug byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba yum gyi pad mar dkyil 'khor rdzogs par gyur nas phyir spros pa rdul tshon gyi lha dang dbyer med du byas pa la skye mched sogs byin gyis brlabs nas dbang bskur ba la mchod par bshad cing*/ phreng bar rang nyid gtso bo'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas bris pa'i dkyil 'khor bsangs te bsrung 'khor phur btab sogs kyi yan lag dang bcas pa'i rten dang brten pa rdzogs par bsgoms pa'i rjes su/ phyag rgya dang snyoms par zhugs pa nas spros pa'i bar snga ma ltar byas te bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor la gnyis su med par bcug nas snga ma bzhin byed par gsungs so/ /lugs gsum po 'di las snga ma gnyis ni bdag mdun tha mi dad du byed par gsal la/ phyi mas gcig tu byed pa ltar snang yang*/ phreng ba rang gi mngon rtogs rnal 'byor rdzogs phraing bsgom na/ dngos su dkyil 'khor gyi shar nas nub du kha bltas te 'dug kyang bsgom don la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug par mos nas mngon rtogs rdzogs par bsgom pa la ye shes pa 'jug pa'i tshul gyis bdag mdun gcig tu 'thad kyang 'dir ni rang gzhung thun mong min pa rnams las bdag mdun tha dad du gsal ba ltar bya zhing*/ de yang mdun bskyed la dam tshig pa mi bskyed pa dang bskyed kyang rang nyid gtso bor mi bsgom pa byas na rtsa rgyud las/ de yi dbus su 'dod pa bya/ /zhes sogs kyi mdun bskyed kyi dbus su rig ma dang rang nyid snyoms 'jug bya bar gsungs pa dang 'gal bas rang nyid gtso bor byas pa'i dam tshig pa bskyed par bya zhing sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhugs par dngos su ma gsungs kyang de yang 'jug par gzhung gzhan du ma nas bshad pa ltar bya'o/

/de ltar na/ rang nyid phyi dro khrus byas shing dri zhim pos byugs chas gos dmar po gyon cing bstod g.yogs dang gtsug tor sogs kyi rgyan dang ldan par byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo la mngon du phyogs par stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ las thams cad pa'i bum chub la de dang yi ge gsum bzlas pas bsang zhing bsrungs la/ rdor dril bzung ste/ bdag bskyed nyer bsdu'i bar du rdzogs par bsgoms nas oṃ shū n+ya tā nas haṃ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba gur bla re me ri dang bcas pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'i 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i nang du saṃ las rdo rje saṃ gyis mtshan pa/ zhes pa nas/ lung dang rtogs pa'i chos thams cad rnam par dag par gyur pa'i dbus kyi zla ba'i steng du maṃ las ral gri maṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhes pa nas ko3 haṃ/ rang gi mdun du sme sha can gyi bu mo mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa yongs su gyur pa las maṃ las ral gri maṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma sku mdog dang rtsa zhal/ zhes pa nas ko3 haṃ/ shar gyi ling tshe la sogs pa gdan bco brgyad kyi steng du/ bruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ khaṃ raṃ hūm̐ bzhi rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'khor lo/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ ut+pal dmar po| pad+ma/ ut+pal ser po/ me long dmar po/ pi wang sngon po/ dri'i dung chos/ ro'i snod kha dog sna tshogs pa/ chos kyi 'byung gnas/ tho ba/ dbyug pa/ pad+ma/ rdo rje rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las lha bco brgyad du gyur pa ni/ shar du rnam snang dkar po/ zhes sogs nas/ chos dbyings rdo rje ma'i 'jug tu de thams cad kyang zhabs gnyis zhes pa nas gshegs pa gzhan gsum nyi ma'i 'od 'phro ba/

shar sgor gshin rje gshed nag po zhes sogs nas/ g.yon rkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /yum gyi spyi gtsug nas snying kha'i bar du zhes pa nas/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgras/ ji ltar bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa zhes pa nas/ shap+da pra tī ts+tsha swāhā/ ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ chags pa chen po'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i laṃ nas yum gyi pad mar babs pa'i thig le yongs su gyur pa las ye shes pa lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal la yongs su rdzogs pa rnams yum gyi pad ma nas spros/ oṃ ya mān+ta kri ta dzaḥ gshin rje mthar byed kyi dzaḥ dmar po'i zhes pa nas mnyes par gyur/ lha thams cad kyi mig gnyis su/ zhes pa nas blugs pa'o/ /lha thams cad kyi nu ma gnyis kyi zhes pa nas/ sngags thams cad kyi bar yum la bshad pa bzhin bya/ de nas yab yum gnyis kyi thugs rdo rje'i gong du/ zhes pa nas yab yum gnyis la mi skyod pa dang rnam snang sogs de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi dang*/ zhes pa nas dbu rgyan par gyur/ dbang lha thams cad kyang gnyis su med par thim/ zhes pa'i bar la| 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ zhes dang*/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab yum sku mdog dmar ser ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi yum dang yab la 'khyud cing zhes sbyar ro/ rang gi thugs kha'i maṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ sngar bzhin mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbasgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam mo/ / gnyis pa ni/ mchod pa bsangs sbyang las bum gyi chus byas nas byin gyis brlabs te mchod phreng ltar rgyas par phul zhing bstod nas bzlas pa'i mthar yi ge brgya pa lan bdun brjod/

sgrubs thabs ltar gtor ma phul nas/ rang nyid gtso bo las gtso bo gnyis par bya ste/ sgrub grogs dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug nas| dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol lam yol ba'i phyi rol tu phyin te/ phyogs skyong bcu'am/ bco lnga la gtor ma sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin phul nas gshegs su gsol nas nye reg byas la/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi nga rgyal gyi sum+bha ni drag du bzla zhing nang du zhugs te rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du phyin nas lha rnams steng nas skor bar mos shing*/ dngos su me ri'i phyi nas rdo rje'i 'gros kyi sum+bha ni bzlos zhing g.yas skor lan gsum byas la/ shar sgo nas lhag chad byung ba dran pa rnams gso zhing mi dran pa kha bskang ba'i don du khro bo'i lta bas gtso bo la lta zhing snyems pa dang bcas pas/ oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan// sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hi hi hi/ mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol/ zhes so/ /de'i rgya skad kyis me tog sngon po phul| slar yang skor nas nub sgo'i thad nas rkang pa bzhi bca' sngon du 'gro ba'i g.yon rkyang dang lag pa pad skor chen po sngon du 'gro ba'i hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcings pa bkrol te/ oṃ badz+ra ud gha ta sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ shar sgo nas phye bar gyur zhes brjod cing bsam/ de bzhin du byang nas lho dang shar nas nub dang*/ lho nas byang sgo phye la/ slar yang bskor te shar sgo nas gar byed cing sa ma ya pra be sha yā mi zhes brjod pas me tog phreng ba blangs te/ mgo la bcing*/ mnyam pa'i rkang stabs dang thal mo sbyar nas/ oṃ pra ṇa mā mi sarba ta thā ga tā na/ zhes pas phyag byas la/ sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod| mi spro na me tog 'bul len med pa'ang bshad do/ /de nas skabs 'dir gsungs pa'i sbyin sreg rgyas par bya zhing ma grub na/

yid kyis mos pa tsam bya'o/ / gsum pa la rang 'jug pa dang*/ gzhan la dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du 'dug nas bla ma'i bya ba rnams gtso bo dang slob ma'i bya ba rnams rang gis byas te/ 'og nas ji ltar 'chad pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par blangs la/ slob dpon gyi las thams cad la gnang ba thob par byas la slob ma gzhug pa'i don du dam tshig gsum gyi glu dang de kho na nyid kyi bstod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bden stobs 'di brjod par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor la sngon du phyogs par 'greng te rdor dril dang bcas pas dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma mtha' ma med pa'i mchog/sems dpa' rdo rje rang che bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /'gyur med mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa med pa rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod/ /shin tu dga' ba chos kyi mchog |gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid| |byang chub sems par bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog |dbang phyug chen po rgyal mchog gi /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag grub mdzod/ /sems can kun yid khyab pa po/ /sems can kun gyi yid la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab nyid de/ /dam tshig mchog gyur 'dod pa mchog /bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog/shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor yin/ /bden pa de yis mgon po khyod/ /bdag gi 'dod pa yongs rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med| |bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag 'byung*/

/de nyid de bzhin nyid des 'byung*/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma ni/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog/ces brjod do/ / gnyis pa la 'jug pa dang*/ zhugs pa la dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po la gdong g.yogs dang bcas te dang dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i bdag nyid du 'jug pa'o| |dang po la yol ba'i phyi 'jug dang nang 'jug go / dang po ni/ yol ba'i phyi rol du sngar lhag gnas byas pa'i slob ma rnams khrus byas lus la dri bzang po byugs/ kha dri zhim par byas/ rgyan gyi rnam pa rnams bzhag la/ chas gos rnams dang lhan cig las thams cad pa'i chus bsang zhing bzlas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bo dhi a laṃ ka ra was+t+ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra na sa ma ya shrī āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas gos dmar po'i smad g.yogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ zhes pas stod g.yogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ zhes pas gtsug tor dang oṃ tsak+ṣu ra ban+dha wa ra ma nā ya hūm̐/ zhes pas mig dar bcings la/ slar yang slob ma las thams cad pas bsangs te skad cig gis rnam snang dkar po/ zhes pa nas nor bu dang pad ma 'dzin pa'i snying khar rdo rje la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ nag po/ mgrin par pad ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ spyi bor 'khor lo la gnas pa'i zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po rnams kyis lus 'od gsal bar byas shing shar sgo'i thad kyi phyi rol du gnas par gyur pa bsgom du gzhug cing*/ rigs dang mos pa shes pa'i phyir du/ kye khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /zhes bla mas dris nas skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhes lan 'debs su gzhug la 'jug yon dang man+ḍal dang*/ bdug spos la sogs pa'i mchod pa 'bul du bcug te| ā khaṃ wi ra hūm̐/ zhes pas me tog gi phreng ba lag pa gnyis kyi bar du byin nas hūm̐ zhes brjod du bcug la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam pa'i smon pa'i sems kun rdzob pa de nyid snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam pa can dang*/

chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i stong pa nyid dang rang gi sems ro gcig tu gyur pa'i don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems de nyid zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa can du gyur par mos nas thams cad rnal 'byor du sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas thal mo sbyar te/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa ta yā mi zhes brjod du bcug la/ bla mas me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje de'i snying khar bzung ste/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sing+nghi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ deng khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur gyis khyod kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes gsang bar gdams par bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ bla mas/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas slob ma dngos su yol ba'i nang du bcug cing*/ bsgom don la dkyil 'khor gyi nang du bcug par mos pa gnyis kas bskyed/ mahā ra ta su ḍi ḍha su to ṣo su su ṣo badz+ra sa twa a dh+yā sing+ngh+yā maṃ zhes pas yid kyis lha rnams kyi steng du dngos su dkyil 'khor gyi phyi nas g.yas bskor byed du bcug la/ shar sgo mi skyod pa rnam snang| lho sgor rin 'byung*/ nub sgor 'od dpag med/ byang sgor don grub du mos su bzhug cing*/ lus thams cad sa la phab pa dang*/ thal mo snying khar sbyar nas dpral ba sa la reg pa dang*/ dpral bar sbyar nas kha dang*/ spyi bo sbyar ba snying khar phab nas/ spyi bo sa la reg pa rnams kyi phyag byed du bcug la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza u pas+tha nā ya at+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa twa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa maṃ hūm̐ dang*/ oṃ sarba bung+ngha pū dza u bas+tha nā ya āt+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bai ro tsa na a dhi tiṣ+ṭha maṃ/

te sngags tshan gnyis dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe kā ya āt+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣ-iñtsa maṃ dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra warta nā ya at+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra pra warta ya maṃ dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma ṇe ād+mā naṃ nīr+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru maṃ/ zhes pa rnams brjod pas sgo bzhir rim pa bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod cing snyen bskur ba dang*/

mchod cing dbang bskur ba dang*/ mchod cing chos 'khor bskor ba dang*/ mchod cing 'phrin las phun tshogs kyi nus pa can du byin gyis rlobs par gyur pa'i mos pa 'dzin du gzhugs/ sngags rnams kyi don yang mi zhes pa yan chad/ sngags dang po gnyis la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod cing bsnyen bskur ba dang*/ phyi ma gsum la rim pa bzhin/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ chos 'khor bskor ba dang*/ mchod pa'i las rnams kyi phyir bdag 'bul bas/ zhes pa yin la/ de man chad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' dang rnam par snang mdzad kyis byin gyis brlobs shig ces pa dang rdo rje rin chen gyi dbang bskur ba dang*/ rdo rje'i chos rab tu bskor ba dang*/ rdo rje'i las mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'o/ /de nas shar sgo bla ma'i zhabs la phyag bya ste/ oṃ gu ru tsa raṇā ya u pas+thā nā ya āt+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba sa twa pa ri tra ṇāthāṃ āt+mā naṃ ni r+yā ta yā mi/ zhes pa bla ma'i zhabs la bsnyen bkur ba dang sems can yongs su skyabs pa'i don du bdag dbul bar bgyi zhes pas phyag bya'o| |'dir phyag lnga ni phreng ba nas 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa'i shar sgo'i nang gi lha snam steng du gnas pas dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes sogs kyi thun mong gi sdom pa sngar bzhin 'dzin du bcug la/ mgo bor rdo rje bzhag nas deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis des na ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub rnams kyang thob par gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos ci dgos khyod kyi kyang 'di dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ zhes pa gtso bor phan yon gyisgo nas dang slar yang rdo rje mgo bor bzhag nas/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/

khyod kyis tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na 'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gems par gyur ro/ /zhes gtso bor nyes dmigs dang*/ rdo rje snying khar bzhag nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyis/ /snying la yang dag gzhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ zhes pa gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag de nas thod pa'i bdud rtsi lnga'am dung chos kyi dri'i chu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed| |dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ / oṃ badz+ra ud ka ṭha/ zhes brjod pas 'thung du bcug ste rdo rje'i mna' bsgag de'i spyi bor lag pa bzhag la/ deng phyin chad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis ngas 'di gyis shig ces byas pa de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig byas na ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar lhung bar gyur ta re/ zhes slob dpon gyi bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag ste/ dang po gsum rtsa ltung bdun pa dang 'di dang po dang*/ bzhi pa dam tshig spyi la dam bzhag byas pa ste gsum pa yang phreng ba bzhin bkod pa'o/ /de nas slob mas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlobs shig rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod du bcug la/ de 'od dpag med du gsal ba'i snying khar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po'i grwa bzhi rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbus su hūm̐ nag po lkog mar baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po bum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su āḥdamar po/ spyi bo yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa'i dbus su ha dkar po rkang pa gnyis kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa'i steng na raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum me 'bar ba rkang pa gnyis kyi long bu'i 'og tu yi ge dzhaiḥdamar po me'i rang bzhin can/

bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te rlung g.yos me sbar ba'i shugs kyi dzhai'i me 'od rkang pa'i bu ga nas zhugs pas lus thams cad gang*/ sa'i dkyil 'khor bsregs pas chu'i dkyil 'khor khol ba rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis mnan pas chu'i dkyil 'khor las bdud rtsi babs pa sa'i dkyil 'khor la thim pas lus bde drod 'bar zhing sems shin tu tshim par gyur/ slar yang bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis dpal ldan 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs te de'i lus la char ltar babs shing thim par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam nas bdud rtsi lnga dang gu gul la sogs pa'i rdzas bsreg rol mo drag tu dkrol zhing ā be sha ya stam+bha ya ra ra ra ra tsa la ya tsa la ya hūṃ a āḥ dzhaiḥzhes pa bcu brjod| des ma phebs na brgya la sogs pa brjod cing dbab bo/ /phebs ma thag tu de gsung rdo rjer gsal ba'i lce la thig le dmar po'i steng du āḥbakod de/ bru hi badz+ra| zhes brjod cing dge mi dge sogs ston par gyur zhing*/ rnam 'gyur ye ma zhi na gshegs su gsol la/ de lta ma yin na rdo rje spyi bor bzhag nas tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes pas brtan par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bar snang la mig dar dang bcas bzhin pas ltar bcug la/ ji ltar snang zhes dris dkar ser dmar nag ljang bar snang na rim pa bzhin zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las sna tshogs 'grub par lung bstan sngar btang ba'i me tog phreng ba'i gseb nas yang zhing ma rnyings pa'i me tog bton te rin po che'i me tog du mos nas traṃ zhes bsngags pas slob ma la byin des kyang lha bcu dgu'i ngo bo la bzang ngan med kyang rang gi rigs bdag gang yin pa de'i dbu la 'bab par shog cig snyam pas pra tī ts+tsha badz+ra/ zhes brjod de dor bas gang la phog pa de'i rigs su brda sprad cing*/
