lha de'i yang sku stod dang bar dang sku smad la phog na rab 'bring tha ma yin la/ de yang gtsug tor raṃ mdzod spu la ni phyag chen/ spyan nam zhal la babs na sngags kyi dngos grub/ sku la ma phog kyang nye na dngos grub myur du 'grub la ring na yun ring pos 'grub/ lha gnas re mig gis bcad pa gnyis lta bu'i bar du lhung na gang la nye ba de dang*/ mnyam na gang la mos pa de'i rigs dang rtsig pa'i phyi rol du lhung na lan gsum skyar zhing skyar yang dir lhung ba'am rdo rje rwa ba'i phyi rol du lhung na dkyil 'khor mi bstan zhing tshogs bsog du bzhug go /de nas me tog de sngar gyi me tog phreng ba dang lhan cig slob ma'i mgo la bla mas bcings te pra ti grih+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la/ zhes me tog phog pa'i lha la bos nas slob ma 'di byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rjes su zung shig ces gtad pa ni dbang dang po me tog phreng ba'i dbang ngo*/ /'dir mkhas rlom gang dgame tog 'ching ba po dang sngags brjod pa po me tog phog pa'i lha de yin zhing*| sngags don yang*/ slob ma khyod kyis byang chub kyi sems 'di zung shig ces pa yin no zhes zer ba ni/ 'di'i skabs kyi rgyud de nyid bsdus pa rtsa 'grel dang 'gal zhing dbang 'di slob dpon las ma thob par yang 'gyur ro/ /de nas de'i mig gnyis su oṃ 'od zer 'bar ba re res mtshan par gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyis/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /ces pas mig dar dkrol/ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /dngos grub kun ni phun sum tshogs| |dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyis/ /rdo rje pad ma rtse rol bas/ / gsang sngags rnams la sgrub pa gyis/

/he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ zhes brjod la dkyil 'khor la ltar bcug la/ phyi rdul tshon lta bu'i dkyil 'khor mtshon nas/ nang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rten mtha' nas dang*/ brten pa nang nas mngon rtogs bzhin du rgyas par bstan la/ bdag 'jug gi tshe dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha bcu dgu'i dky-il 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mthong bar gyur/ zhes brjod do| |gnyis pa la bum dbang dang mchog dbang ngo*/ dang po la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang ngo*/ /dang po la'ang dngos dang de'i mtha' rten no/ /dang po la chu dang cod pan dang rdo rje dril bu dang ming gi dbang ngo*/ /dang po ni/ des yon dang phyag dang man+ḍal phul te/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu sgral ba'i phyir/ / nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsaul/ /bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis slob ma drangs ba zhal nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs rgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad mar babs pa skad cig gis stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las mi skyod pa nag po nag dkar sogs nas 'dzin pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe nas shab+ta tāts+tshi swāhā/ rdo rje spyan gyi sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba skyab pa'i ched du dbang*/ /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal/ /de ltar 'di la bstsal du gsol/ /zhes de rnams dang sgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor ba la gsol ba btab pas nam mkha'i rgyal ba yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ 'dod chags chen po'i mes zhu bar gyur/ rnam snang gi sgo nas zhugs rdo rje'i lam nas byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyis slob ma mi skyod par byas pa la dbang bskur/

yum gyi pad ma nas phyung ste dkyil 'khor gyi shar du khrus dkyil mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du shing stan la gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad ma dang zla ba'i gdan la 'khod par gyur par bsam zhing*/ grub na dang po khrus stegs phyi nas rim pa bzhin du dkar dmar nag pa'i rtsig pa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa 'phar ma gnyis dang ldan pa'i dbus shar lho nub byang rnams su rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che pad ma ral gri rnams nag dkar ser dmar ljang khus mtshan pa'i steng du shing bstan la sna tshogs pad zla bris pa'i steng du dngos su'ang bzhag go /de nas bum chu bsdus pa rnam rgyal gyi chu/ las thams cad pas bsangs/ shū n+ya tās sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje zhes pa nas/ 'dzin pa zhes pa'i bar gyis mi skyod par bskyed pa snga ma ltar byas la/ khyad par mi skyod pa nag po mi skyod pa'i dbu rgyan can zhes sbyar/ ye shes pa snga ma ltar bcugarang gi rigs bdag yab yum gyi byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang bskur ba la snga ma bzhin mchod/ de yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i bum chur gyur/ zhes pas dbang rdzas bsgrubs la/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i ting 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od zer gyis gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha spyan drangs pa rnams nam mkhar 'khod| zhes pa nas gsol gyi bar mngon rtogs bzhin byas/ gsol ba btab pas sgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor ba rnams dang rigs lngas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ spyan ma la sogs pa rig ma dang bcas pa nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa rang gi steng phyogs su 'dzin/ glu gar mdzad cing rol mo brdung me tog dang gur gum la sogs pa'i char 'bebs| phyag gis cung zad yo bar bzung ba'i bum pa dkar po byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gyis gang ba rnams kyis dbang bskur/ sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu dbyangs dang bcas pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/

khro bo khro mo rnams phyogs mtshams su 'khod nas bgegs bskrad par gyur/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gsum dang dbang bskur rdo rje sogs nas hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ bde ba chen po myong*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu 'khyil ba yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyi dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs nas slob ma'i ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas thim pa la sngar bzhin mchod/ de dag gi ṛg pa'i dbang lnga las mi skyod pa chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang gi dri ma sbyangs rnam shes kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ mi skyod pa dang de'i rigs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so/ /zhes dbang gi dag pa brjod/ de bzhin du dbang 'og ma bzhi dang rdo rje slob dpon gyi chung dbang la'ang 'dir brjod pa'i dbang rdzas skye chog dang dbang lha spyan 'dren nas dag pa'i bar 'don pa spos nas bya zhing rig pa'i dbang lhag ma rnams la phreng bar nang dbang dngos su ma gsungs pa ltar byed na slob ma dang dbang rdzas lhan cig bskyed/ dbang rdzas la rigs bdag rang chas su byas pas dbang bskur nas mchod/ gzhan rnams 'dra bar bya/ nang dbang yang bibhu tīs mdzad pa ltar spro na'ang bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ras sam rin po che sogs las byas pa'i cod pan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa bsangs sbyangs/ aṃ dang rin po che las rin 'byung du bskyed pa sogs dang*/ slob ma'ang de bzhin du bskyed pa sogs byas nas bkra shis tshigs bcad kyi 'jug du sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che/ /dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa ste/ /rin chen kun gyi mchog 'gro bas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi shiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes pa mgo la skon badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hos dar dpyangs du bcug la/

dbang bskur rdo rje nas/ 'khyil pa yongs su gyur pa las rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes pa nas mchod/ de bzhin du dag pa la'ang rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan/ ser sna/ tshor ba'i/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ rin chen 'byung ldan dang zhes sogs sbyar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ rdo rje dang slob ma dz+riṃ dang pad ma las 'od dpag med du bskyed pa sogs byas nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che/ /zhes pa'i gnas su/ sangs rgyas kun gyis rdo rje'i dbang*/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /de 'di sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rab tu grub phyir rdo rje bzungs/ /oṃ badz+ra abhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya sta/ zhes pas lag pa g.yas su gtad/ dbang bskur rdo rje nas/ 'khyil ba yongs su gyur pa las 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan/ 'od dpag med rdo rje'i/ 'dod chags/ 'du shes/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ 'od dpag med dang*/ zhes sogs sbyar ro/ / bzhi pa ni/ dril bu dang slob ma khaṃ dang ral gri las don grub du bskyed pa sogs byas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi zhes pa'i gnas su/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang zhes pa nas dril bu bzungs zhes pa'i bar snga ma'i 'don pa sgyur la/ sngags kyang snga mas lag pa g.yon du gtad/ chu dbang yang sngar bzhin bskur bas don grub kyis dbu brgyan/ don grub dril bu/ phrag doga'adu byed/ bya ba grub/ don grub dang*/ zhes sogs so/

/ lnga pa ni/ slob ma bruṃ dang 'khor lo las rnam snang du bskyed/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid sogs kyi gnas su/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang*/ /de ring khyod la bkur bar bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /grub phyir rdo rje'i ming 'di zungs/ /oṃ badz+ra adhi pa ti twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sing dhi sa ma ya twaṃ bhur bhu waḥswa āḥ zhes dril bu spyi bor dkrol/ chu dbang sngar bzhin bskur/ rnam snang ming gi gti mug gi/ gzugs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ rnam snang dang zhes sbyar ro/ /yang na dril bu dang ming gnyis kyi tshigs bcad/ thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yis/ / 'gro don mnyam med byed pa dang*/ /mchod pa'i las rnams rdzogs byed phyir/ / rdo rjes las kyi dbang bskur ro/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje ming gis dbang bskur bas/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /cis kyang mi shig mi g.yo bar/ /rdo rje'i ming du rab sgrags kyis/ /zhes pa sbyar zhing*/ ming la mi skyod pa'i rigs yin na/ bzhad pa dang*| sgeg pa dang*/ gnyis med dang mi phyed pa dang*/ dga' rab dang rol ba sogs dang*/ rnam snang gi rigs la gti mug dang*/ rtag pa dang*/ oṃ mdzad dang*/ sgyu 'phrul dang*/ snang mdzad sogs dang*/ rin 'byung gi rigs la/ yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ nam mkha' dang*/ gzi brjid dang*/ yon tan 'od sogs dang*/ 'od dpag med kyi rigs la/ 'dod chags dang*/ chos dang*/ pad ma dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dang*/ gsung gi rdo rje sogs dang*/ don grub kyi rigs la/ rta mchog dang*| las dang*/ dam tshig dang*/ don yod sogs kyi mgor dpal dang mjug tu rdo rje gdags par shān+ti pas bshad la/ dus kyi 'khor lor ni rdo rje sngon du 'gro bar gsungs so/ /lha mo la rdo rje'i rigs la/ bdag med ma dang*/ rdo rje dbyings phyug ma sogs dang*/

'khor lo'i la/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ sgeg mo sogs dang*/ rin po che la mā ma ki dang do shal ma la sogs dang*/ pad ma'i la gos dkar mo dang*| dbyangs can ma sogs dang*/ las kyi sgrol ma dang*/ las ma dang*/ snyems ma la sogs pa'o/ /de ltar rig pa'i dbang lnga thob pas spang bya ma rig pa lnga spong rig pa ye shes lnga thob par byed de/ rgyu mtshan de nyid kyis sam/ dbang de rnams gtso bor rig mas bskur bas na rig pa'i dbang zhes bya zhing*/ rang la dngos kun gang snang ba/ /de ni gtso chen 'jam dbyangs rgyal/ /gang de'i sangs rgyas ye shes nyid| |chos kun rang bzhin gyis 'dag pa'o/ /zhes snang ba thams cad 'jam dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul du gyur pa'i rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du shes par gyis shigazhes brjod do/ / gnyis pa ni/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa ste/ slob dpon dbang gi sngon 'gro yin pas na 'di'i mtha' rten du grub pas/ thog mar rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ rdo rje sems dpar gyur/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ / phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /stong pa nyid dang gnyis su med pa'i rgyal ba'i ye shes ni gsang ba'i rdo rje yin la de dran par byed pa'i don du rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rdo rje'i de kho na nyid kyi sgo nas bzungs shigaces lag pa g.yas su gtad la| des kyang lag pa g.yas su cung zad sor te snying khar bzung la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sing dhi badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa taṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra sa twa hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das mchog gi dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /zhes brjod du bzhug go /de ni rdo rje'i rtul zhugs sam dam tshig go

/de nas dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ /kun tu bzang mor gyur/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bu/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /shes rab dbyings kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i sgra dril bus sgrog par sems pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i de kho na nyid kyi sgo nas zungs shig ces pa lag pa g.yon du gtad la/ des kyang dkrol zhing*/ āḥsrid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pas/ /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur| |zhes brjod du bcug ste/ /dril bu'i brtul zhugs sogs so/ /de nas slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ /gtso bo yab yum dang bcas pa thun mtshams kyi lhar gsal gdab pa bzhin du skad cig gis bskyed la/ lha sku yab yum la dmigs pa gsal bar 'dzin du bzhug ste/ gzugs sogs 'dod pa'i dam tshig gis/ / gsang sngags ma tshang med par bzlos/ /rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo de/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum khyab gyur pa'i/ /rang gi lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /mi bzang dka' thub sdom pa ni/ /brten kyang mi snang mngon shes dang*| |mkha' spyod sku gsung thugs rnams las/ /byung ba'i dngos grub 'grub mi 'gyur| |de bas sangs rgyas sems dpa' mchog /sngags kyi spyod mchog spyod pa rnams| |'dod pa thams cad brten pa yis/ /'gyur med mchog gi chos rnyes so/ /sdug bsngal ma yin bdag bde bas/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams bsten| |gang gzhan dman par bshad pa yang*/ /sngags kyi bzlas pas 'grub 'gyur zhing*/ /ye shes don gnyer chags can gyi/ /sbyor bas sku gsung thugs rnams ni/ /sgoms na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /lus mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i lha sku sgyu ma lta bu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bor dran pas ye shes kyi phyag rgya 'dus byas nas 'dod yon thams cad la longs spyod par gyis shig ces pa ni lha sku phyag rgya chen po'i dam tshig sogs so/

/de nas slob ma dbang de tsam gyis tshim na 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags kyi rjes gnang bya zhing*/ spro zhing dad pa bskyed pa'i rkyen du 'gyur na lung bstan dbugs dbyung yang byas la yon blangs te 'jug chog bya'o| | gnyis pa la/ dngos dang mtha' brten no/ /dang po ni/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul sngar bshad pa bzhin gyi rigs lnga'i sdom pa sgrag bzung byas nas byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba 'debs su bcug pa la chu dbang sngon du bshad pa'i nang dbang bskur| khyad par rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du bskyed/ 'dir skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa rgyas bsdus gang rung bya zhing shing bstan gyi gnas su seng ge'i khri'i steng du pad ma dang zla ba'i gdan la 'khod pa'i steng du gdugs dkar po dang g.yas g.yon du rgyal mtshan dang ba dan gyis brgyan par gyur| rdo rje thugs dang dril bu gsung dang lha sku phyag rgya chen po'i dam tshig gsum gyi de kho na nyid lhag par dran bzhin pa'i ngang nas yab yum phan tshun 'khyud pa la dmigs pa ched du gtad pa las byung ba'i bde ba skyes/ bde ba des stong pa nges pa'i bde stong dbyer med du sbyar ba'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can slob dpon gyi dbang gi ngo bo rgyud la skyes par mos su bcug la/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rje byin gyis brlobs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas chu dbang gi skabs kyi bla ma'i thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' zhes pa nas sngar bzhin mchod/ zhes pa'i bar bya'o/ / gnyis pa la/ de kho na nyid bstan pa dang rjes gnang sbyin pa'o/ /dang po la| dkyil 'khor dang*/ lha dang*/ slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid do/ /dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi grwa bzhi la sogs pa rnams lung rtogs kyi chos rnam par dag pa ni 'di lta ste/ mi mnyam med pa zur bzhi ste/

/sangs rgyas sangs rgyas min par mnyam| |byang chub phyir du lus tshor dang*/ /chos gang sems rnams gcig dang ni| |du ma'i sbyor bral dran pa dang*/ /de la dad gang shar sgo'o/ /byung dang 'byung 'gyur phyin ci log /spangs shing mi bskyed pa dang ni/ /yang dag ma skyes skyes rnams kyang*/ /bskyed dang gnas pa bzhi rnams dang*/ /brtson 'grus lho yi sgo zhes bya| |'dun dang brtson 'grus sems pa dang*/ /spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dang*/ / dran pa 'di ni nub sgo'o/ /dad dang brtson 'grus dran bsam gtan/ /shes rab dbang stobs mnyam med dang*/ /ting nge 'dzin yang byang de ltar/ /dran nas dbang stobs sgo bzhi yin/ /dang po la sogs bsam gtan bzhi/ /rta babs bzhi ni 'byung ba ste/ /dpa' bar 'gro dang mkha' mdzod sogs/ /ting 'dzin kha khyer yin par bshad/ /lag na mchod thogs g.yen spyo rnams/ /tshig la sogs pa'i gzungs kyi tshogs/ /gang phyir sna tshogs brgyad ldan pa/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa'o/ /ba dan sna tshogs rlung gis bskyod/ /rtse mor dril btags sgra sgrogs ni/ /gdul byas bskyong ba'i dam pa'i chos/ /yan lag sgra kun sgrogs pa'o| |drwa ba drwa phyed nyi zla dang*/ /rnga yab me long me tog phreng*/ /phyogs kun 'od rab gsal ba ni/ /ye shes me long byang yan lag /'khor lo can sogs ka ba yis| |de yi nang gi 'khor lo gang*/ /dkyil 'khor brgyad pa lta bu ni/ /rnam thar brgyad po rnam dag pa'o/ /kun nas yongs su zlum por ni/ /rdo rje'i thig gis rab skor ba/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje theg par rab ston pa'o| |tshon lnga rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /'gro la ye shes kyis chags pa'o/ / bum pa gang de'i rdo rje can/ /ye shes bdud rtsi gsol ba'am/ /shes rab thugs rjes rlan pa yis/ /tshogs rnams rdzogs pa'i rgyu mthun no/ /dkyil 'khor gang du me tog spos/ /mar me che dang drir bshad pa/

/byang chub yan lag yid rab tshim/ / chos kyi snang ba grags bsdus yin/ /lha bshos chos kyi zas yin no/ /gos rnams ngo tsha khrel yod do/ /glu gar rol mo dbyangs snyan rnams/ /bde ba chen po rab 'phel ba'o/ khang bzang thar pa'i grong khyer te/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bsdus pa yin| |zhes pa'am/ yang na mngon rtogs bzhin brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ dad dang brtson 'grus dran bsam gtan/ /rnam dag sgo bsrung mchog gi gzugs/ /sbyin sogs phar phyin drug dag pas/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje sogs rang bzhin/ /sa thabs mtshan med la sogs phyir/ /spyan sogs gsang ba'i ngo bau yin/ /sems can don dang bdag rnam rig/'jug pa'i rnam shes rnam dag pas/ /me long la sogs ye shes ni/ /sangs rgyas lnga po kun gyi dngos/ / ma skyes ye shes sbyor ba yis/ /'khor lo'i gtso bor snang ba'o/ /zhes brjod do/ / de nas gzugs dang lang tsho yis/ /yon tan ldan pa'i bu mo dang*/ /sbyor ba'i dam tshig rnal 'byor gyis/ /mchog gi slob dpon der 'dug la/ /ye shes dbab la rab tu brtag/rdo rje pad ma kha phye la/ /sangs rgyas rang nang bzhugs bya ste/ /pad ma la gnas brtan par bya/ /rigs bdag gnang ba thob nas ni/ /rang ming rdo rje'i bdag brjod pa'i/ /sbyor bas dkyil 'khor spro bar bya/ /rdo rje pad ma'i sgras sangs rgyas/ /spyan drangs 'khor lo'i phyogs logs su/ /bgegs rnams bsal la yang dag bsrungs/ /mchod yon phul la rab tu mchod/ /yang dag bstod de sgo bas bskor/ /las rnams byas nas sgrub bya ba/ /mig dang sku sogs byin brlabs la| |dbang bskur mchod pa la sogs rtag /dngos grub kun stsaul sems can don| |mdzod cig ces ni gsol ba bdab/ ces pa mdun bskyed bsgrub cing mchod pa'i las dang*/ de bzhin du lha la rab tu gnas pa dang*/ slob ma dbang bskur ba dang*/ bza' bsrung gi dam tshig la sogs pa ni slob dpon las rim gyis de nyid do/

gnyis pa n-i/ rang dang slob ma gtso bo sems dpa' gsum brtseg tu gsal ba'i rang gi ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du bla ma'i zhal nas de'i zhal du zhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mtha' skor te gnas par gyur/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūṃ ces sogs brgya rtsa brgyad rjes bzlos byed du bcug la/ rang g-is/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /ces lan gsum gyis gtso bo la gsol ba gdab/ slob mas kyang*/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyis/ bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug go |des ni sngags kyi 'phrin las thams cad bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so/ /de nas yi ge pra las skyes pa'i gser gyi mig thur pra zhes byin gyis brlabs/ de'i mig gnyis su yi ge praṃ nag po la ma rig pa'i ling thog thams cad 'dus par gyur| oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hriḥ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ / 'jig rten ling thog gsal bar ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /ma rig pa'i ling thog dang bral nas ye shes kyi spyan bye bar gyur/ des chos thams cad me long gi gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar lta'o/ / zhes snyan pa'i phyir du as sngags pa'i me long a/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyaug pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag 'byung*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /der ni gsal dag rnyog pa med/ /rang bzhin med cing gnas med par/ /chos rnams de ltar shes nas khyod/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /skyob pa rnams kyi sras su skye/ /spyir chos thams cad me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu dang khyad par du rang gi snying la shar ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' me long gi gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar shes par gyis shig

/ces pas mig thur me long gi rjes gnang dang*/ de nas rkang pa'i 'og tu 'khor lo byin la/ bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ/ dung lag pa g.yas su gtad nas 'bud du bcug la/ dbyangs tha ma aḥlas byung ba'i dung*| oṃ badz+ra bha ṣa raṃ/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi glegs bam gtad la glog tu bcug la/ dbyangs dang po a las byung ba'i gsang 'dus kyi po ti a/ deng nas brtsams ste sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos dung bla med pa/ kun nas yongs su bkang nas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /dril bu lag pa g.yon du byin la/ /dbyangs tha ma aḥlas skyes pa'i dril bu/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa nyid sbyor ba/ /thams cad mchog ni mnyam nyid gsal/ /zhes brjod de/ ho las skyes pa'i mda' gzhu ho/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya swa/ zhes pas gtad/ des kyang sā'i gnas su mi bcug pa brjod cing phyogs bzhi steng 'og dang drug du 'phen pa'i stangs bya/ de'i tshe rang gis sngags snga ma brjod/ de nas slob ma gtso bor gsal ba la/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ / zhes thun mong du brjod nas phyag mtshan rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che pad+ma ral gri rnams re re zhing byin te/ chos kyi gnas su rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ las kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ zhes pa rigs lnga'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i rjes gnang sbyin no/ /bum dbang tsam gyis tshim pa'i slob ma yin na lung bstan dbugs dbyung dang*/ dam tshig rjes gnang 'og tu 'chad pa rnams 'dir byas la yon blang zhing 'jug chog bya'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor rnam pa bzhi las phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi las bum pa'i dbang thob/ abhi ṣe ka ta'i sgra la yi ge phyis bsnan gyi nges tshig sbyar na/

se tsan gtor ba'am 'khru bar byed pas na dbang ste bum chus gtor bas lus tha mal du snang zhing zhen pa'i dri ma 'khrud/ nirta ṣik+ta lugs su blug par byed pas na dbang ste phung khams skye mched lha'i rnam ldan du bsgyur bar byed/ shak+tis+tha pa ti nus pa 'jog pas na dbang ste sprul sku'i nus pa 'jog wa shaṃ ka ro ti dbang bar byed pas na dbang ste bskyed rim yan lag dang bcas pa bsgoms pa dang*/ dam tshig nyer gnyis bsrungs ba la dbang*/ kar+ya pak+ṣi ti 'bras bu mngon du gyur pas na dbang ste sku rdo rje sngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so/ /zhes dag pa bshad do/ /gnyis pa gsang dbang ni/ bum dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i slob mar dbang po yang rab rdzogs rim la don gnyer drag po dang ldan pas bla ma la tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang rin po che'i man+ḍal la sogs pas mnyes par byas/ gzugs dang lang tshor ldan zhing legs par bslabs pa'i rig ma dngos sam yid kyis sprul ste/ rdo rje sems khyod sangs rgyas kun gyi bde ba bsgrub pa ste/ /rnam dag byang chub sems dpa' rgya chen sras su gyur pa rnams/ /yun ring stong pa nyid bsgoms pas ni rab tu gdungs pa la/ /dga' ba yid 'ong bde ba chen po nyid kyi mnyes par mdzod| |'dod chags de ni dri med kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa ste/ /dag pa'i rdo rje 'dod chags dam tshig las ni phye mdzad nas/ /dka' ba rnam pa drug po spyod pas shin tu gdungs pa rnams/ /rab tu dges dbang 'dod pa'i bde ba nyid la 'jog par mdzod/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod ni dbang mchog bgyid mdzad cing*/ /rdo rje pad+mo phye ba'i tshul gyis sbyor mdzad de/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gzugs kyi sku ni rab bton nas| |bde ba thams cad sgrub pa nyid kyis mnyes mdzad gsol/ /ces gsol ba gdab/ kun spyod khyad par can/ gsang rdzas la ma dad pa dag pa'i ched du mig dar bcing*/

las thams cad pas bsrung ste/ rnam snang du bskyed/ rang nyid gtso bo sems dpa' sum rtseg du gsal bar gyur/ rig ma bsnyen sogs 'bring po'i tshul gyi yum du bskyed pa dang rnam snang sogs kyi yi ges brgyan pa mkha' gsang byin brlabs mngon rtogs bzhin byas nas/ rang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i shin tu dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te zhal nas zhugs pa rjes su chags pa'i mes byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu gyur pa rnams rim gyis sku'i dbyibs rgyud pas dga' bzhi rdzogs par bskyed pa'i thig le nor bu'i rtser gnas pa de nyid 'theb srin gyis phyung ste/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyi/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems ni bzang po yis| |de bzhin bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐ zhes pas slob ma'i lce thog tu bzhag des kyang sangs rgyas thams cad zhu ba 'dus pa'i ngo bos rang gi lus la gnas pa'i rgyal ba rnams tshim par bya ba'i bsam pas myang la/ a ho ma hā su kha zhes brjod/ yum gyis kyang rang gi chu skyes na gnas pa'i sbrang rtsi bton nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig chen po rmad byung ba/ khams lnga las byung bcud kyi len/ /bde ba chen po myang bar gyis/ /oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐ zhes pas lce thog tu bzhag pa sngar ltar myang zhing brjod/ de ltar bla ma yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar myangs pas bde ba skyes/ bde ba des stong pa nges pa'i bde stong dbyer med du sbyar ba'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can gsang dbang gi ngo bo rgyud la skyes par mos pa byed du bzhug go /de nas mig dar dkrol ste/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor bzhi las| kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ dbang bzhi las gsang ba'i dbang thob/ dri ma bzhi las ngag gi dri ma thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa dag par byed/

lam bzhi las rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang sgyu lus yan lag dang bcas pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ sku bzhi las longs sku dang rdo rje bzhi las gsung rdo rje'i sa bon bzhag cing mngon du 'gyur pa'i nus pa can du byas so/ /zhes dag pa brjod do| |gsum pa ni/ phyag dang man+ḍal ston du 'gro ba'i rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa phul ba'am der mos nas/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnams sbyaung ba/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsaul/ khyod zhabs pad+ma spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis| |'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen pos/ /de bas sangs rgyas mchog brnyes mdzod| |sdug bsngal kun gyi gnas gyur pa'i/ /dmyal ba nas ni gtso bos grongs| |sdug bsngal thams cad mthar mdzad pa/ /mgon med bdag la thugs rjes mdzod/ /ces gsol ba gtab/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brda dang phan tshun ngo tshas bcings pa spangs ba'i phyir du mig dar bcings/ bla mas rig ma de chos dbyings rdo rje mar bskyed pa rgyan tham cad kyis brgyan pa lus dri zhim pos byugs te/ lag pa nas bzung ba slob ma'i lag par gtad la/ de'i spyi bor rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa bzhag nas/ 'dir ni khyed rnams dpang po yin/ /bdag gis 'di la 'di gtad do/ /zhes rgyal ba rnams dpang du btsugs te/ gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis btags/ /'khor lo rim pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa myong bar gyis/ /rdo rje dkyil krung gis sems ni/ /nor bu'i nang du gnas par blta/ /zhes brjod de byin/ de nas rig ma des/ smos shig bu khyod rdo rje can/ /bshang dang gci ba za ba dang*/ /sha dang khu khrag de bzhin ste/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*/ /bha ga'i pad mor 'o byed dam| |zhes pa'i lan du/ khu khrag la sogs za ba dang/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*/

/bha ga'i pad mor 'o byed pa/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /zhes lan btab pas/ rig ma des mnyes nas gos phud de rang gi chu skyes rgyas pa gsal bar bston zhing*/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan/ / gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa/ /de yi mdun na nga gnas so/ /sangs rgyas mnyes pa la sogs pa/ /pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ / 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /bhañtsa mok+ṣa ho zhes gsungs zhing slob ma'i dpang du byon| de nas slob ma 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang rig ma 'jam pa'i rdo rje mar gyur pa'i gnyis ka'ang sku mdog dmar ser sngon dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis phan tshun du 'khyud cing lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis ud pa la dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ yab rdo rje'i dkyil dkrungs dang yum pad ma'i dkyil dkrung gis phan tshun du 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang gzhon nu lang tsho sogs nas/ lha 'dir sna tshogs kyi nam bza' bsnams pa'i bar mngon rtogs kyi yab yum gyi skabs bzhin dang*/ khyad par thabs dang shes rab kyi yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ zhes dang*/ de gnyis kyi mig gnyis su sogs nas/ rgyas gdab kyi bar yang yum bzhin du byas/ yum gyi lus dang mkha' gsang byin rlabs mngon rtogs bzhin du byas te/ bla ma'i ye shes sems dpa'i 'od zer gyis de'i lus kyi lha gsal zhing chags par byas pa rnams rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar zhugs pa de'i lus kyi lha yang gsal zhing chags par byas pa de'i kha nas slob ma'i khar zhugs 'khor lo ltar 'khor bar gyur/ si ta/ shi shi shi ha ha ha/ zhes sogs ngag gis kyang rjes su chags par byas/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i rtsa btsal nas/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas mkha' gsang reg pa bsnyen pa dang snang ba/ rdo rje pad mar zhugs pa nyer bsgrub dang mched pa/

yang yang sgul zhing skyong pa bsgrub pa dang nyer thob/ gtum mo ye shes kyi me 'bar bas byang chub kyi sems zhu nas thams cad stong pa 'od gsal bde ba chen po dang stong pa nyid mnyam par sbyar ba'i bsgrub chen kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos su bcug nas/ oṃ sa rba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal 'dzin du bzhug byang sems nor bu'i rtser brtan par gnas pa yun ring du bzung*| ma thub na dal bus btang te pad ma nas lce rtses blangs la btung du bzhug yid kyis sgoms pa'i rig ma la yang de lta bu'i bde stong sbyor ba'i mos pa brtan pa dang migs phyed par byas te/ bde stong gi ye shes de nyid la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang du ngo 'phrod pa gal che'o/ /de nas slob mas shes rab ma la phyag byas la/ gzhi yi don la bdag 'khrul bas/ /g.yang sa 'di ru yun ring 'khyams//

rgyal dka' 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab las/ /mgon khyod kyis ni de ring bsgral/ khyod ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /gdul bya'i dbang gis sku sprul pa/ bdag sogs rnams kyis mchod bya'i phyir/ /bdag gi bsam pa 'di bzhes shig /ces brjod bla mas slob ma la/ dbang bskur 'di ni ji ltar bar/ /byang chub spyod gzhan de bzhin du| |dge ba'i tshul ni gzhan gsungs pa/ /kun gyis sangs rgyas sogs mi thob// de bas bu khyod dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa rtag tu skyangs bar bya/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' zhing*/ /de las gzhan yang dam tshig bsrung*/ /dkon mchog gnod byed gzhom bya ste/ /bud med thams cad spyad par bya/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du gang bshad pa| |'di dag cho ga bzhin du bsrungs/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla med pa'o/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'das gyur na/ /dngos grub mchog kyang 'grub mi 'gyur/ /zhes pas rig ma'i brtul zhugs sbyin no/ /de nas gdong g.yogs dkrol la/ khyod kyi dkyil 'khor bzhi las bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bzhi las shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ spang bya bzhi las yid kyi dri ma thun mong dang thun mong min pa dag lam bzhi las dga' ba bar ma'am 'od gsal gyi rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu bzh-i las chos sku dang rdo rje bzhi las thugs rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so/ /zhes dag pa brjod do/ / bzhi pa la dngos dang mtha' brten no/ /dang po ni/ yon dang maṇ+ḍal dang phyag phul ste/ khyod ni sems can kun gyi yab te yum yang yin/ khyod kyis bdag la sogs pa 'jigs pa che las sgrol/ /'gro pa'i bla ma rje btsun khyod kyis sdug bsngal sel/ /che ba'i che khyod khams gsum 'dor slad skye bo skyongs/ khyod zhabs pad ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*/ /bka' drin gyis ni skyabs tu gsol/

/zhes gsol pa gdab/ 'di'i rang bzhung rnams su dbang bzhi pa gsal bar ma byung yang*/ rgyud sde rnams las| de ltar de bzhin bzhi pa yang*/ la lar/ bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas na 'di'i dkyil 'khor gy-i steng du gsal bar ma bshad cing*/ de yang phreng ba dang*/ de'i rjes 'brangs rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang bhi bha rak+ṣi ta gnyis dang dpal 'dzin dang*/ la ba pa dang*/ ngag dbang grags pa dang*/ sbyor ba bdun ldan rtsa 'grel sogs nas lam zab cing rgya che ba la lhag par mos pa'i slob ma la/ 'bras bu thob bya'i sangs rgyas ky-i bzhugs tshul 'khrul med du go ba skyes pa nyid la dbang bzhi pa'i ngos 'dzin dang*/ de'ang gsum pa dang dpe don du sbyar zhing*/ thob bya de yang slob dpon ngag dbang grags pas/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ /snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi chad dang 'gog pa med/ /yan lag bdun bshad don dang ldan par bsgrub bya 'dir/ /bdag 'dod tshad mas yongs bsgoms blo can gyis kyang sngags/ /zhes dang longs spyod rdzogs pa dang/ kha sbyor dang*/ bde chen dang*/ rang bzhin med pa dang*/ snying rje chen po dang*/ rgyun mi 'chad pa dang*/ 'gog pa med pa ste/ yan lag bdun ldan gsungs pa ltar yin zhing*| de dpe don du sbyar tshul yang*/ sbyor ba bdun par/ rdo rje 'chang ba chen mo yi| |sku chen lta bas mi ngoms pas/ /zhal gsum phyag drug ltar snang ba/ /rnam kun mchog ldan rig mas 'khyud/ /shes rab ye shes dbang dus su'ang*/ /mtshan nyid de yi tshul du gnas/ /zhes dbang gnyis ka la yan lag dang po gnyis tshang zhing*| de bzhin zhes pas gsum pa thabs shes kyi yan lag tshogs pa las byung ba bzhin du bzhi pa de yang de dang 'dra ba dang*/ yang zhes pas gnyis ka yang bde chen tsam dang ldan zhing 'on kyang bzhi pa rgya che ba dang zag pa med pa sogs kyi khyad par du 'phags par bshad pa ltar yin te/

mdor na dbang gnyis ka la lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po gtso bor dgos shing*/ de yang bde chen rkyang pas mi chog gi /rtsa rgyud las dngos po thams cad dang bral ba phung po khams dang skyed mched dang*/ / bzung dang 'dzin pa rnams spangs pa/ /chos la bdag med mnyam nyid pas/ /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes dang 'jam dpal zhal lung las/ gzugs la sogs nas kun mkhyen gyi/ /bar gyi chos rnams rang bzhin ni/ /nam mkha'i dkyil ltar rnam dag pa'i/ /zab gsal gnyis med ye shes te/ /de ni dngos med bsgom pa med/ /ces pa lta bu'i/ thams cad stong pa dang dbyer med du sbyar ba'i thugs dang*/ kha sbyor gyi dang longs spyod rdzogs sku gnyis ro gcig tu zhugs pa'o/ /de'i don bsdus te brjod na/ khyod kyis dbang gsum pa thob pa'i dus su rang dang rig ma gnyis kyi lus 'dod lha yab yum du snang bzhin pa'i dus nyid nas sems lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' bas de kho na nyid bsgoms pa gnyis mnyam du yod pa de bzhin du/ de ni de goms par byas pa las mthar rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i ye shes kyi sku rang snang gi rig ma dang kha sbyor ba'i lus can dang*/ thugs thams cad stong pa 'od gsal las ldang mi srid pa'i tshul gyis zhugs pa'i lhan skyes kyi bde chen gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i zung 'jug gi sku ni thob bya'i 'bras bu mthar thug pa yin no// zhes tshig gis brda sprad pas go ba khyad par can skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo yin no/ /zhes brjod/ de lta bu'i sku dang thugs la bag chags khyad par can bzhag pa'i ched du/ da lta'i slob ma las dang po la'ang lus rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan du byas nas sku legs par gsal btab te/ thugs kyi stong nyid khyad par can sgom du 'jug pa sogs ni byas na'ang rung la ma byas na'ang dbang bzhi pa ma thob par mi 'gyur ro/

/de nas khyod kyis dkyil 'khor bzhi las don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ spang bya bzhi las sgo gsum gyi dri ma'i bag chags 'khrud pa'i nus pa bzhag lam bzhi las zung 'jug gi rdzogs rim sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu bzhi las ngo bo nyid sku dang rdo rje bzhi las rdo rje gsum dbyer med pa rdo rje 'chang gi 'bras bu 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /zhes dag pa brjod do/ / gnyis pa la/ lung bstan/ rjes gnang*/ dbugs dbyung ngo*/ /dang po ni/ bla mas sprul sku shākya thub pa'i cha lugs su byas/ phyag g.yon pas chos gos kyi grwa snying khar bzung*/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas rgyal ba thams cad dang mgrin gcig tu lung bstan par mos nas/ 'dir ni khyed rnams ngas lung bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye dpal zhes sogs nas/ a/ gang zhig de ltar lung bstan pa'i/ /sngags pa 'gro ba kun gyi gtso/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub tu/ /bde gshegs kun gyis lung bston to/ /zhes brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ ngo bo nyid kyi sems can gang*/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba/ /de lta de ltar sems can don/ /chags sogs dag pas bsgrub par gyis| |nyin re bzhin yang thun gsum du/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang*// ldan pas thun mong gcig shos kyi/ /dngos grub thob phyir bsgrub par bya/ /mi snang bar ni stong cig dang*/ /mngon shes ldan pas stong gnyis dang*/ /rig pa 'dzin pa stong gsum dang*/ /rdo rje can gyis 'gro kun bdag/ces pa'i bdag gces pa rkang pa dang po gsum la sbyar ba thun mong gi dngos grub dang thabs mchog tu bshad la/ gzhan yang zhi dang rgyas la sogs/ /gang la ci 'dod las rnams ni/ / 'khor lo rjes mnyes sbyor ba yis/ /sgrubs na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/

/zhes brjod do/ / gsum pa ni/ phyag rgya skyabs sbyin du sgyur nas/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /zhugs pa dang ni mthong ba yis/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol te/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod min te/ /mi thub tshugs pa yod min pas/ cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das| |srid pa shin tu mthar grub pa'i/ /ston pa mchog tu khyod gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun gsungs shing*/ /bka' lung dam pa rtag pa yis/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa ni/ khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya ni// gang zhig skyes pa nyid tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du dogs med pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni btang mi bya/ /dam pa'i chos la smad mi bya/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o// mi shes pa'am gti mug gis/ /rnam par bstan par mi bya'o/ /rang gi bdag nyid yongs btang ste/ /dka' thub kyis kyang gdung mi bya/ /ji ltar bde bas bde bzung na| |'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam| |bla ma sangs rgyas kun mnyam pas/ /slob dpon la ni gang rnyes pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun bsnyas pas/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal thob par gyur/ /rims dang dug dang dbyig dug dang*/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gtse ba dang*/ /bgegs dang log 'dren gtum po yis/ /gsad nas sems can dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo chen po/ /dge ba rab tu mi spyoms pa| |nam yang smad par mi bya'o/ /bla ma la ni gus bcas yon/ /rjes mthun khyod kyis sbyin par bya/ /des ni rims sogs gnod pa rnams/ /phyir zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsrungs/

/rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod| |rtag tu bla ma la dbul bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu byin pa nyid du gyur/ /de byin bsod nams tshogs yin te/ /tshogs las dngos grub mchog tu gyur/ /gang phyir 'di ni legs gnas pas/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /deng khyod dam tshig lha rnams dang*/ /mnyam par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can kun gyis| |de ring tshe ldan dbang bskur te/ khams gsum kun gyis rgyal srid che/ / bdag po nyid du khyod nges so/ /de ring bdud rnams las rgyal te/ /grong khyer dam par rab tu bzhugs/ /deng dus khyed kyis sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gi dmatshig mi bzang bde stong bsten par gyis/ /'gro ba bde ba myur la rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyod ni phyin par gyur/ /zhes brjod cing don bshad do| |de nas 'dir dngos su ma gsungs kyang phreng bar 'byung ba ltar/ slob mas mgo bo'i steng du gdugs dkar po bzung ste dkyil 'khor la lan gsum skor nas shar sgor gdugs gzhan du bzhag ste dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ slob dpon gyis/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur ba'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags| |zhes pa lha la slob ma dbul/ de nas de'i lag pa nas bzung te/ da ni khyod nyid slob dpon gyur/ /sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /lha rnams kyis kyang mthun par bsam/ / sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /zhes khur chen po bskyed du bzhug te/ de ni rig pa'i dbang lnga tsam bskur ba la mi brjod do/ /slob mas kyang gus pa chen pos slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag byas nas thal mo sbyar te/

gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes khas blang ngo*/ / gsum pa mjug chog ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar du zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg rgyas par byas pa'i 'jug tu/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pas de'i g.yas kyi the bong nas khrid de thab la bskor ba byas nas bsreg blugs bdun 'bul du bzhug cing rgyal po'am gnas de'i bdag po'i don dang*/ chos skyong gi ched dang*/ rang gi ched du'ang bdun bdun la sogs pa phul nas sbyin sreg gi mjug chog bya'o/ /de nas slob mas lus sam ci'i 'byor ba'i yon dang phyag phul/ bla mas lus 'bul ba rnams la dge ba'i grogs 'tshol bar bskul/ yo byad thams cad de tshogs rdzogs pa'i ched du bdag gir byas la/ bza' btung dang kun spyod khyad par can gyis mgu bar byas la/ dpon slob gnyis kas dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod rgyas par byas| tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang glu gar sogs kyis/ mtshan thog thag 'das nas/ gsang bar gdams pa'i ched du de la mna' chu blud/ rdo rje snying khar bzung nas las thams cad pa bzla zhing de bzlas pa'i bsrung bskud btags te byang chub kyi bar du legs par bsrung*/ de nas slob ma phyi rol du btang ste/ dkyil 'khor la bzod gsol byas yig brgya brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ muṃḥmadun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa sku'i rigs rnams zhes sogs kyis rang la bsdu/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ a d+ya nut+pan+natwā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ dang por lha mtshan dang de nas gzhan dang*/ de nas tshangs thig rtse nas gtso bo'i bar rdo rjes phyis te rim gyis phyag nas don du gnyer ba yod na cung zad sbyin zhing lhag ma bskur sti chen pos rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chur 'dor ro/ /de nas phur bu rnams sngar gyi sngags rgyas bston nas rdo rje la thim par bsam zhing*/

oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsā na sarba ar+tha sā dha na swāhā zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i 'o mas bkru/ khung bur yang gtor bas bgegs rnams gsos nas sgrib pa dag par bsam la/ phur khung bkang ste chag chag btab nas bsngau ba dang bkra shis bya'o/ /'di'i cho ga'i rim pa rnams ni/ dkyil chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa rtsa 'grel gtso bor byas zhing/ tshigs bcad rnams/ lo chen dang smri ti'i rang 'gyur gnyis bsdur 'grel pa dang bstun nas go bde bar bcos/ kha 'gengs dgos rnams phreng ba la sogs pa dkyil chog 'di'i rjes 'brang rnams kyis bkang pa bzhin bris pa ste/ 'di ni 'jam rdor gyi dkyil chog gtso bor byas la 'jig rten dbang phyug dang mi skyod pa lha bcu dgu ma sogs la'ang 'di kho na ltar sbyar te/ rang rang gi gtso bo dang de'i thugs ka'i mtshan ma sogs kyi 'don pa cung zad spo ba ni khyad par ro/ /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes gzhon nu'i sku/ kha sbyor bde chen yan lag bdun ldan du/ /rtag bzhugs 'jam dbyangs sku bzhi'i nus pa'i dpal/ /gsar du skrun zhing gzhan la'ang sbyar rung ba'i/ dkyil 'khor cho ga mkhas mchog mar me mdzad/ /bzang po'i gzhung la rjes 'brang mkhas rnams kyis/ /de ltar dkral zhing legs par bshad pa yis/ / dge bas 'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin gyur cig

/nang gi nyi mas de yi mun pa ni/ /mtha' dag med pa bcom las smin byed kyi/ /phra mo'i gzugs rnams mngon du ma gyur na/ /bdag nongs de yang nyi mas 'joms gyur cig/ces dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje gtso bor byas te/ bcu dgu ma gsum gyi dkyil chog las dang po pas kyang lag tu blang bar sla ba 'di yang*/ tshul 'di la lhag par mos shing rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mas bskul ba ltar rang nyid kyang spro ba 'phel ba'i rkyen gyis/ dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor pa dge slong lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan bzang pos/ rab byung gi nag pa zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis pa'i nyin dge 'phel chos 'khor sgang du sbyar ba'o| |'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dgos/ sgo thams cad nas phyogs thams cad du rnam pa thams cad kyis dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig | sarba dza ga taṃ maṅgalaṃ// bha wan+tu me shu bhaṃ// //rang nyid bdag 'jug len pa la ni/ /slob dpon nam rang ces pa'i gnas su/ /bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa zhes pa dang*/ /slob ma'am de zhes pa'i gnas su/ /rang nyid ces pa bcug pa nyid kyis 'grub bo/ / ༈ oṃ swasti/ dge legs srid zhi'i phun tshogs 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /rab dkar yon tan du ma'i 'byung gnas mchog /dpag yas phun tshogs stsol ba'i nor 'dzin gang*/ /paṇa chen pradzñā'i mtshan can gang de rgyal/ /gang gi blo gros 'dzin ma'i khyon yangs las/ /sna tshogs legs bshad lo tog ji snyed 'khrungs/ khyad par skye rgu'i rgud sel dpag bsam shing*/ /rnam mang 'bras bu'i g.yur za brjid pa 'di/ /dge 'phel chos 'khor sgang 'dir spar du bsgrubs/ /'di yi mthun rkyen grwa pa sbyin bdag dang*/ /gtso bor bla brang shar nas sgrubs pa yi/ /do dam dka' bcu dbang seng pa yis bgyis/ /tshul 'di yi ger 'god byed tshul khrims 'phel/

/rig byed spar gyi 'du byed chos kyi bzang*/ /gang de'i dri ma 'khrud pa'i chu dag pa/ /brda sprod kun dga' 'od zer zhes bya'o/ /phyogs 'dir gang gi lus dang longs spyod kyis/ /'bad cing dus gsum dge ba chu klung des/ /kun mkhyen chu gter chen por myur bgrod nas/ /'jam rdor klu dbang mchog de 'grub par shog/ // maṅgalaṃ// bha wan+tu// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs/ -PAGE 282--PAGE 281--PAGE 279-
